row.name: 2024: Aliens Are Coming
row.detailed_description: EARLY ACCESS Game is currently an early access demo that only contains the first 3 levels. See Early Access details to know the expected development timeline. A storm is brewing behind the scenes. You start out as a normal, unsuspecting person on Earth, but your story is about to turn upside down as you encounter UFOs, Aliens, and the military. Aliens Are Coming to Earth, and some hard choices are coming your way. What will you do? Who will you trust? What will you fight for? How will it all turn out? This Indie Single Player Sci-Fi Adventure/RPG game will send you beyond Earth and back again as you get swept up into all of the secrecy surrounding Aliens and UFOs. Visit exotic places, meet Aliens, make alliances and enemies alike as you make critical decisions and fight for what you think is right. Time is short, because it's 2024, and Aliens Are Coming ! This story rich 2D side-scroller adventure game is in early release. The initial early release experience is mostly a cinematic experience with 2 mini-games (motorcycle racing and stealth/sneaking). As more scenes are added to the game, you will eventually: Choose your character's specialties, stats, and skills over time through your dialogue and action choices Learn to use psionic powers such as telekinesis, telepathy, shielding, remote viewing, psionic blasts, and healing Acquire your own top-secret military black-triangle spaceship and travel to several unique adventures on Earth, the Moon, Mars, Ceres, Ganymede, Space Stations, and eventually even planets in other star systems once your ship unlocks the wormhole jump upgrade. Encounter unique characters throughout the story who can become your companions as you travel through space As a roleplaying adventure game, gameplay will vary widely as more areas are added to the game, which will include: 2D space shooter fighting and travel 2D beat-em-up style fighting with secret high-tech weaponry when on the ground or in a spaceship Psionic training minigames to build your focus Diplomatic encounters with high-stakes dialogue choices Companion/party management as you manage your subordinates' skills and equipment Keep an open mind and prepare yourself for the secrets and changes to your reality, because Aliens Are Coming !

row.name: Subvirtual
row.detailed_description: Story Follow along with Zivraye on an adventure through the subvirtual! The story of Subvirtual is analogous to the creation process, such that closing the Infinity Chest at the end is akin to completing the MagiRouter -a device used to communicate from the Zivraye universe to many many others. Zivraye's sojourn will take you across all 7 background arenas! Gameplay Subvirtual consists of cubes that form a subgrid. Cubes can be dug up (uncovered) using the VR shovel hand and flagged using the VR flag hand. Cubes uncovered, which are not bombs, will show either a number or will be blank. Blanks mean no bombs directly surround that cube; while numbers indicate how many bombs border that cube. Use this information to uncover all non-bomb locations and you win the match! GL HF! If you enjoy logic & numbers, this is the game for you! Game Modes Campaign: Experience the story of Subvirtual while playing through 21 hand picked matches spread over 7 unique arenas ('All Arenas Bundle' item purchase NOT required for Campaign). Custom Game: this match type is the 'classic' experience. It is the playstyle used in the campaign mode. Allows player selections of both subgrid size (smol/medium/large) as well as difficulty (easy/medium/hard) Memory Test: this match type is, as the name suggest, a memory game. Cubes will flash in order, adding 1 cube per round, and the player mush recover (fill) cubes in the same order that was flashed. Bomb Sniffer: Need a break from the other game modes? This match type is impossible to lose! The subgrid contains only 1 bomb! You win when you blow up! Additional Features Unlockables: level up to unlock configurable options for each part of the flag & shovel VR hands with different colors & shaders. We're excited to see the custom combinations you come up with! Distinct Arenas: all 7 of the arenas that are featured in the campaign present themselves with a distinct atmospheric vibe that gives each arena a unique sense of identity while you play. Which will be your favorite background aesthetic? Atmospheric Music: Subvirtual's sound track was hand picked by Zivraye. A few tracks play on all arenas, but most arenas have 2-4 songs unique to that arena. Statistics: see how many cubes you have uncovered, games won, and more!
row.short_description: Clear the subgrid of cubes without touching the bombs by sorting out how many connections are safe! Happy puzzling!

Returning home from your interstellar travels, you stumble upon a mining station that presents the perfect opportunity to upgrade your outdated spaceship. row.name: Pal-Mon
row.detailed_description: This game is not really a game. It is an interactive podcast, aimed at bringing awareness to specific issues within the gaming industry. Mainly, it dives into the impact of copyright and patent disputes on creativity. Through its simple mechanics, Pal-Mon  sparks a conversation about fairness, innovation, and the future of gaming. Each level is designed as a parody of another game that had mechanics that were patented. You can choose to play through these game parodies while listening to the podcast. Gameplay is very simple, usually moving a 2D character around on the screen using WASD. But for the most part you really don't have to do anything except listen unless you want to. The podcast features narration from the developer themself. This adds a personal touch to the experience, and allows for a deeper dive into how patents affects small scale, solo developers. The perspective is from the indie scene. However, the point is made that unfair legal action hurts every game studio, no matter its size. Whether you're here for the casual gameplay or the deeper commentary, Pal-Mon  invites you to play, enjoy, and reflect on what truly matters in the gaming community.
row.short_description: A thought-provoking indie game developed in Godot that uses casual mechanics to spark a conversation about creativity and fairness in gaming. You perform pointless tasks while The Developer talks at you. Satirical humor, goofy artwork, and an unsurprising end make this game worth playing--maybe.

row.name: Battle for Rakir
row.detailed_description: Battle for Rakir is an open-world, isometric (top-down) space combat game. This RPG is set in orbit around the war-torn desert colony of Rakir. Rakir, once a slave world, has risen in rebellion against its master, the tyrannical Federation; a galactic power that exploits its colonies for profit. As a new recruit in Rakir’s amateur spy division, you’ll pilot advanced spacecraft, command small strike fleets, and carry out daring missions to sabotage the Federation. The planned gameplay loop is to level up your pilot, customize your build with hundreds of abilities, and make key decisions in a branching campaign that shapes the fate of the rebellion.  This is a solo indie project. Please help me to make it better, with your suggestions and by reporting any game breaking bugs.

row.detailed_description: Wonderland is a top-down turn-based strategy game that requires real-time action, where you will play as a little girl who wakes up and falls into Wonderland. Will you be able to realize the truth of your misadventure? Will you escape or resist, fight or reconcile? Through each level, gradually understand the little girl's inner story and discover the secrets of Wonderland. You will use: WASD (to move) left and right mouse buttons (to trigger effects). In the journey of exploration, you will encounter all kinds of new and mysterious elements. Maybe it's the [locked board space], what you see is - the board and the blocked heart door, find the key, through the difficulties, keep moving forward may be able to find the answer. The game's playing area is an irregular board made up of multiple square squares, and players can move in all directions on the board, with each level requiring a different way to obtain the key, unlock it, and pass the level. Or the [Pocket Watch] that accompanies you on your journey, a pocket watch that you hold firmly in your hand when you wake up, and every time the hands rotate, the world changes in some way. But you seem unaffected. You'll also encounter the menacing [Very Different Black Mud Creations], strange creatures that appear out of nowhere, recklessly blitzing and leaving traps, each arching the key in their own way to impede your forward progress. Strictly moving with time, they only act once every week that the pocket watch rotates. Utilizing the regularity of the action perhaps they can be an aid to you as well. On your journey, you can always utilize the Energy of Rotation, two types of energy in Wonderland, which are filled up over time, rotating every time the pocket watch rotates for a week. You can use the energy to perform special actions instantly, or you can scribble it on the board grid for later use. Of course, there is also the most precious companion on the journey. In Wonderland, travel companions with different personalities are waiting for you, happy, idealistic, obsessive, they each have their own troubles and perseverance, and I believe you will spend a memorable time with them. By observing, anticipating, and acting with full consideration of time and space, players will be able to gradually master the law of energy circulation, utilize their own sealed & current energy to achieve various game goals, and explore the final ending. row.name: StormCore
row.detailed_description: StormCore is a dynamic third-person shooter with roguelite elements. Play as a forgotten cyborg, reactivated to save a dying alien planet from its creators’ catastrophic mistakes. With modular limbs and great firepower, blast through hordes of alien insects, optimize your build, obtain powerful upgrades, and reach the StormCore terraformer tower before the world collapses in just three days. KEY FEATURES Cybernetic limbs Mix and match 4 limb types/abilities (Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Kicks, Movement) to tailor your experience to your own playstyle and build. Powerful upgrades Defeat enemies and grow stronger. Each fight won means one more stack of one of 12 distinct upgrades that grow stronger with each stack. Try out various builds based on your choice of limbs and upgrades, and become an unstoppable force of destruction. Roguelite progression For each 3-day cycle, use the first 2 days to build up your strength. Dying isn’t the end, keep your upgrades and try harder the next day. You play as The Pilot and their army of speedbots—built to run, crash, and start all over again in a frenetic time-trial race! All thanks to our sponsors, of course. Competition Above All! Take the top spot on the leaderboard! Other contenders want the #1 rank, but you’re more relentless. Replay the level as many times as needed to secure the highest score—so don’t hold back. Show your robot fury to the competition and dominate the leaderboard! Master Speedbot! This exceptionally dangerous sport is practiced only by robots designed for this purpose. Very few make it to the finish line, as countless obstacles stand in their way. Will you be the first champion of this Speedbot Tournament? A Breathtaking Valley! The races take place in a sprawling landscape, blending natural and industrial settings with a solarpunk-inspired art direction. You’ll die often—but what a stunning valley to behold as you do! Game Features - Race through 10 levels with increasing difficulty. - Improve your mastery of the character and the environment! - Use gameplay elements to optimize your path and get the best time!  - Survive obstacles during your run! - Climb the Leaderboard and compare your scores with friends! - Earn as many Medals as possible ! aim higher and higher ! row.name: 橙子小白大冒险
row.detailed_description: 剧情： 橙子和他的哥哥小白，以及自己的娃娃和宠物狗被卷入了奇怪的事件之中。一行人一路吐槽着击败作业之神手下的勇者们，拯救世界(?)的恶搞吐槽向RPG。 顺便偶尔遇到一些稀奇古怪的敌人，大战莫名其妙复活的名人，勇闯规则性怪谈学校，遭遇诡异的营销号，被暴露的肌肉福瑞吓出八级内伤等等。 相互理解而又不能相互理解的人们的叹息无人可闻。 特色： 极度传统、复古的回合制RPG体验，强调战术，使用性能各异的角色，搭配各种效果的装备和技能，利用有吐槽有梗的怪物图鉴针对每个敌人的特点与敌人战斗。 传送、遇敌禁用、战斗快进、逃跑时100%成功、阵亡角色仍能获得经验等大量方便机制。 但我特意保留了一部分传统RPG的糟粕，这样你才能知道你玩的是传统RPG。 (被打飞，当然没有，肯定不会把九转大肠端上来的啦♥️) 个性鲜明的角色们。 太过鲜明了以至于有些画面不能放出来。 随处可见的吐槽和出生。 脱线而又谜之合理的剧情和背景故事，这一点可能还要包括敌人。 与整个世界为敌。 4小时+游戏时长。完美通关也许还需要更久。 “刺猬效应”——两只刺猬相互依偎取暖，但如果距离太近就会被扎得浑身鲜血。有时，适当保持距离也是好事。尽管这听起来很扭曲。 备注： 本游戏本体免费，付费dlc包含二周目、其余结局、困难模式和一些追加剧情。具体可见dlc页面介绍。 可以理解成超大型demo，付费购入完整版XDDD。这样的话存档也能公用呢。不过放心，本体内容还是很完整的，量绝对够XDDD 目前，二周目仍在开发中。
row.short_description: 爆笑的传统回合制RPG！强调战术的战斗风格和极其有梗的怪物图鉴，能带来极其复古的JRPG体验。与橙子和小白一起，带上自己家谜之站起来的修狗，战胜作业怪，打倒ky小鬼，干碎营销号，与整个世界为敌(?)吧！

row.name: Fateful Destiny
row.detailed_description: Fateful Destiny is a short narrative-driven adventure set in a small village where mystery lurks beneath the surface. Playing as a young farmer, you’ll uncover the story by exploring the town, speaking to its inhabitants, and piecing together clues. Designed to be completed in about twenty minutes, it offers a unique experience: decisions are final, and once finished, it’s not meant to be played again. Every choice shapes your understanding of the truth in this fleeting yet impactful journey.
row.short_description: Can you uncover the truth, or will the mystery remain buried? Explore a village, make final choices, and shape a story you can never undo.

row.name: 1-Bit Explorer
row.detailed_description: 1-Bit Explorer is an adventure game focused on exploration where you do NOT save the world and the world does NOT need saving. The point is to explore to your heart's content and uncover mysteries and secrets (or don't, it's up to you, really). You are the son of Frank, regular citizen of Moneta Village, which is trying to complete his collection of Ancient Coins. Due to a disease, your father needs your help with this apparently mundane task of gathering 3 Ancient Coins. Each one requires you to explore a bit of the village and its habitants. What you might discover is that there are secrets, ghosts, other dimensions, demons and ancient Kings hiding in the corners. It is up to you to discover this mysteries. The gameplay consists mostly of various puzzles, either being: Conversational Puzzles: Talk your way into making some people do as you want. Saying the right things might turn them into useful people for your quests. Push & Pull Puzzles: Rocks can be moved around the environment to either unblock a path or to press buttons and special locations, revealing secrets and opening new pathways. Lever Puzzles: Levers can be used to unblock paths, either by activating them in a certain order, activating them in a time limit or simply finding your way into them to uncover new shorcuts. Timing Puzzles: Some puzzles require you to do tasks in a certain time limit. Be careful with the timer, because it might be the difference between just failing or straight up dying! Positional Puzzles: Puzzles might require you to stand on different places in different orders. Be aware of sounds that can indicate a success or failure! Environmental Sound Puzzles: Some times you just need to follow your ears. Be aware of your surroundings and seek out the sounds! Active Combat: If you are willing to explore, you might fight your way into a battle or two. Make sure to learn the ropes with a helpful weaponsmith! Explore, explore and explore: The game is focused on exploration, so make sure to check every corner and talk to everyone! The world is there for you to experience and discover!
row.short_description: An adventure game focused on exploration where you do NOT save the world and the world does NOT need saving.

row.name: Tsukuyomi: The Divine Hunter
row.detailed_description: ■ Deckbuilding Roguelike In this dungeon-exploration game, players use a variety of cards with different abilities to battle enemies and make their way forward. Each run is unique—the types of cards you acquire and the structure of the dungeon change every time you play. Lose a battle, and everything you’ve gained during that run will be lost. ■ Battle System Combat unfolds as a turn-based card battle. Players draw cards at random from their deck and must adapt their strategy to the current situation. Each turn, you can take a single action: attack or defend using a card from your hand. ■ Dungeon Exploration While exploring, you’ll encounter branching paths and various events that require you to make key decisions. Each choice you make may significantly affect the outcome of your journey... ■ Story In Tokyo’s bayside area stands “THE HASHIRA,” a state-of-the-art, ultra-high-rise complex. The tower has become a sealed-off space crawling with monstrous beings. To eliminate the target lurking at the very top, Tsukuyomi, an elite organization sworn to protect the nation, begins its mission— ※ Supported languages: Japanese, English, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese (planned).
row.short_description: A New World from Visionary Creator Kazuma Kaneko This roguelike card game is the latest work by the legendary creator, known for countless masterpieces.

row.name: Epiko World
row.detailed_description: About This Game Epiko World is an action-packed multiplayer battle game that seamlessly blends mythological storytelling with futuristic combat. Step into a vibrant universe where legendary heroes and gods clash in dynamic battlegrounds inspired by cultures from around the globe. Whether you’re engaging in fast-paced PvP matches, teaming up in 3v3 battles, or hunting down epic Ravagers, Epiko World delivers an adrenaline-filled experience for gamers of all skill levels. Key Features Dynamic Gameplay Modes PvP Duels : Face off against opponents in intense 1v1 battles. 3v3 Team Matches : Work together to dominate the battlefield in fast-paced strategic combat. Free-for-All Chaos : Compete against up to seven players in a thrilling fight for supremacy. Ravager Encounters : Hunt down powerful creatures within the arena for rare rewards and an edge in battle. Mythology Meets Futurism Play as gods, warriors, and futuristic heroes, each with unique abilities and weapons, blending ancient myths with cutting-edge technology. Explore battlegrounds inspired by legendary locations such as Dwarka, Babylon, and Mayan temples, complete with dynamic weather and interactive terrain. Customizable Heroes and Companions Personalize your heroes with unlockable skins, weapons, and abilities to match your playstyle. Summon powerful companions to assist in battle, offering tactical and magical advantages. Progression and Rewards Climb leaderboards and complete daily challenges to earn exclusive rewards. Participate in global tournaments for a chance to win rare in-game items and claim your spot as a top competitor. Cross-Ecosystem Integration Bring your NFTs from Epiko Market to life, unlocking unique in-game benefits and customizations. Connect your account through the Epiko Hub (coming soon), where gameplay activities and achievements will earn KARMA points for real-world and in-game rewards. Why Choose Epiko World? Immersive Storytelling : Dive into a world where every battle unfolds a story rooted in rich cultural myths. Cutting-Edge Visuals : Experience stunning graphics, smooth animations, and vibrant environments. Accessible and Competitive : Designed for casual players and hardcore gamers alike, with balanced gameplay and competitive features. Prepare to unleash legendary heroes, conquer mythological realms, and forge your destiny in Epiko World ! Will you rise to the challenge and claim victory? The battle awaits!!!
row.short_description: Epiko World is a fast-paced multiplayer battle game where players engage in PvP duels, team-based combat, and free-for-all chaos. Customize legendary heroes, summon tactical companions, and fight in dynamic maps inspired by global mythology and cultural epics.

row.detailed_description: A Christmas Tale in a Dystopia When students Graff and Ott are called upon to celebrate 'Natal Untail,' a corrupted version of Atlasia's ancient tradition, they'll discover that even in this decaying world, the values of sharing and friendship endure as life's greatest treasures. Do I need to play BROK the InvestiGator first? Nope! This story serves as a prequel to the main game, introducing the characters and explain the game’s terminology. While playing BROK the InvestiGator first provides additional context, this visual novel is a valid entry point into the BROK universe. What is the length? I have written and made this visual novel in approximately 3 weeks of work, this re-uses a large majority of assets from the main game, and spans about an hour to get through. Accessibility This visual novel has full accessibility for blind players in English. Special Edition The original version is free, but the upgraded 'Special Edition' of Natal Tail, revisited for consoles, with choices, achievements and new scenes is now also available on PC as a DLC to support the developer!
row.short_description: A Christmas tale set in the world of BROK the InvestiGator, presented as a visual novel.

row.name: Metabrawl

The best fighters across the space come together to compete to reign victorious for the illustrious title of champion. The meta-ryft, a world that connects all dimensions, and houses many powerful items, welcomes the fight. Metabrawl delivers adrenaline-packed action and intense battles in a vibrant and dynamic world. Choose your fighter and step into the arena, where skill and strategy determine victory. Whether you’re taking on up to 3 opponents in chaotic brawls or going head-to-head in a classic 1v1 showdown, Metabrawl offers non-stop excitement. Story Mode Exploration : Dive into the open-world story mode and uncover the secrets of the Metabrawl universe while honing your skills. Powerful Fighters : Play as unique characters like Wolverinu , the ferocious brawler, or face off against fierce opponents such as Volt , Shiba , or Shibnobi . Work together with a collection of unlikely friends to solve the hidden puzzles and make your escape! Escape From Castle Claymount is a 3D point-and-click adventure game filled with beautifully rendered Claymation scenery and unique puzzles. Explore every nook and cranny to find every item and puzzle solution. Can you escape without being caught? row.short_description: A 3D point-and-click puzzle adventure featuring beautifully rendered claymation scenery and a colorful cast of characters. Search for clues and solve the hidden puzzles to Escape from Castle Claymount!

row.name: JR's Christmas Adventure
row.detailed_description: 'JR’s Christmas Adventure: A Holiday Conspiracy Unfolds!' Join Jessica on her unpredictable journey as she volunteers at her favorite holiday charity, only to be entangled in a web of intrigue and deception. Your choices will shape the outcome of her story, leading you down paths filled with laughter, drama, and unexpected twists. Will Jessica make it home safely? Will she trust the wrong people or uncover hidden truths? Will she finally get that warm drink she's been craving? As you navigate this interactive fiction adventure, you will discover secrets, meet quirky characters, and unravel a conspiracy that will keep you guessing until the end. But be warned: not everyone is as they seem, including Saint Nick himself... Features: 9 unique endings to uncover Multiple paths to choose from, shaping Jessica's story Quirky characters and secrets Join the holiday hijinks in 'JR’s Christmas Adventure' for free! Thank you for visiting my page! This product is unpolished and has rough edges, but if you can look past that, there is fun to be found. It was completed in five rushed weeks by a single passionate gamer who pretends to be a dev. They were learning new AI tools and made a lot of mistakes. They promise to learn from their mistakes, and they appreciate your forgiveness for any foolishness that transpires.
row.short_description: Join Jessica in this humorous holiday FMV adventure. With 9 unique endings to discover, will you find joy or chaos?

row.name: Stan

Your goal is to correctly record 10 pages of music before your label drops you, or before your Stan gets inside. row.short_description: A very short, 2D side-scroller collect-a-thon game that lets you play as the cute HOLORO mascots!

row.name: Idle Legion
row.detailed_description: Kind-hearted person, please save the broken Dark Lord! Our beloved leader, the unholy and terrifying Dark Lord, has been betrayed by the treacherous Death Knights in his campaign against the filthy humans! It is up to us, his loyal servants, to piece back his shattered soul in this abandoned Dungeon. We must rebuild, collect resources, and re-muster our Legions for the glory of our evil master! Observe, analyze, plan, and change the battle!   Focus on your legion's combat, analyze key moments and positions. Adjust formations to ensure victory for Dark Lords! A single legion move can change the outcome—this game tests sharp insight and strategic thinking. A game that combines dungeon management with card-based army battles. The developers of this game are fans of simulation and management games. In the past, while playing other simulation management games, We felt a significant regret: after spending a lot of time carefully designing and managing my city or base, the only reward was an increase in in-game economic income, allowing me to build larger and more powerful structures. However, as you can imagine, once my economy is strong, what I need is an army and warfare! By establishing my economic foundation through simulation management, I aim to support the formation of an army to conquer enemies! Therefore, we merged dungeon management with card-based army battles to create this game, and we hope it brings you enjoyable moments.
row.short_description: Observe, analyze, plan, and change the battle! Focus on your legion's combat, analyze key moments and positions. Adjust formations to ensure victory for Dark Lords! A single legion move can change the outcome—this game tests sharp insight and strategic thinking.

row.name: TDP4: Team Battle
row.detailed_description: TDP4: Team Battle - a Free-To-Play 2D multiplayer platformer shooter game with RPG elements! * Features various game modes: Deathmatch (DM), Team Deathmatch (TDM), Capture the Flag (CTF), Last Man Standing (LMS), Elimination (ELM) and Duel mode! * More than 40 different weapons: from pistols to futuristic laser weapons! * Powerful skill system. Train your character to become stronger! * Obtain medals and in-game currency prizes for completing different achievements. Get high rating to become the best in TDP4 and the most respected! * Create your own or join an existing clan. Fight for your clan mates and earn rating! Try TDP4: Team Battle right now! Join the game today! Key Features 2D Shooter Various game types RPG skills system Tournaments system Clan system Achievements
row.short_description: TDP4 Team Battle is a real-time multiplayer 2D shooter game with MMORPG elements. The bloody battle for survival among 3 races. There are various types of matches, locations and types of guns. Developed Clan and Tournament system. Test your skills against real enemies!

row.name: Midnight Snack
row.detailed_description: Midnight Snack is a short and surreal first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave. FEATURES Alternative and experimental control scheme. Retro/Pixelart 3D visuals. Short and sweet, the game takes about 30 minutes to complete. THE GAMEPLAY The controls are integrated into the interface itself, modeled after the dials of a conventional microwave. The bottom dial controls the camera direction, while the top dial determines how long the player moves. Once the time has been set, the controls are locked until the top dial stops turning, so be careful. To interact with the dials, only the mouse is required. The player must use these unconventional controls to navigate a strange environment in search of a snack, avoiding various obstacles. THE STORY The game takes place in the protagonist's recurring nightmare. In this nightmare, the protagonist wakes up hungry in the middle of the night, viewing the world from the perspective of a microwave. Before reaching the kitchen, he must navigate through a dark and eerie setting, even being attacked within the dream manifestations of his guilt. Finally, upon reaching the kitchen and opening the microwave on the table, he will find an unpleasant surprise.
row.short_description: A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.

row.name: Lift/Shift
row.detailed_description: Description: Lift/Shift is a horror puzzle game where you play as a research operative of a secret institution investigating a mysterious, ever-changing apartment. Armed with a specialized camera, you must document the transformations of objects across multiple floors of an anomalous building. Be careful: any object can shift between realities, and making correct photos is the only way to stabilize the environment. Make mistakes, and you risk destabilizing not just the apartment, but potentially the entire fabric of reality. Features: Reality-shifting gameplay Atmospheric, minimalist design Increasing complexity with each floor
row.short_description: In Lift/Shift, you're a research agent documenting a strange apartment where objects constantly change. Use your specialized camera to stabilize reality across multiple floors.
row.notes: Dark scenes that may scare some people.

row.name: Hangman
row.detailed_description: The classic Hangman game is now on Steam! Balloon Boy thought he could go for a nice walk through the forest...until the Beast blocked his path! Help Balloon Boy continue on his path by typing in the right words without losing all of your balloons. If you lose all of your balloons, Beast will eat you! Choose between three different difficulties and try to solve as many puzzles as you can!
row.short_description: The classic Hangman game is now on Steam! Help Balloon Boy guess the correct words and phrases to avoid being eaten by the beast.

row.name: Moral Dilemma: The Interview
row.detailed_description: It’s the day of your big interview! The position? ‘Moral Dilemma Judge’—whatever that means. But something about this office feels... off . Maybe it’s the talking printer. Or the anomaly corridor that changes every time you enter. Or the narrator who keeps throwing you into ridiculous life-or-death situations. No, no—it’s probably just your imagination. Must be pre-interview nerves. Good luck out there! Features A story-rich experience with a narrative that is impossible to predict! The Narrator is your friend. Don't question him; you should listen to everything he says. Atmosphere -  Countless whiteboards, sticky notes, posters, and signs. Some seem like the ramblings of a sleep-deprived intern, while others whisper secrets you'd rather not know. Minigames - A very strange interview process involving an IQ quiz, a memory test, counting sheep, and more... Make friends - A talking printer, a chair with a doctorate, a toilet playing the guitar... Choices! Trolley problems, dilemmas in war, hospitals, the city, nature... Puzzles - Walk through The Hallway and don't fall for its tricks, or solve a riddle. Multiple endings with many secrets to discover! Explore Nothing in this office is as it seems. Meet a talking chair with existential dread, count passing sheep to 'test' your IQ, and enter the world's first time machine. There are countless secrets and hidden endings to uncover, some so well-concealed they might remain undiscovered for decades. Moral Dilemmas Should you save one baby or five cans of soup? Throw the world into nuclear armageddon, or... not? Sometimes, doing nothing feels like the hardest choice of all.
row.short_description: A fourth-wall-breaking narrative adventure. It’s interview day, and you really need this job—enough to ignore the talking printer, the anomaly corridor, and the ridiculous life-or-death trials your interviewer keeps putting you in. But deep down, you know... something here is very, very wrong.

row.name: Gameday Mayhem!!
row.detailed_description: Grab a friend, hit the field, and brace yourself for Gameday Mayhem!! – the local multiplayer brawl that asks: 'What if football had no strategy, no rules, and possibly… a rifle?' It's a 3-minute duel where two players run, dodge, tackle, and fumble their way to victory. Want to pass the ball? Sure, but don’t expect your AI teammates to help—they’re barely functional. Think Nidhogg meets American football. So, lace up, lock in, and prepare for zero strategy, all chaos. (and Gameday Mayhem may actually be the worst game!) GameDay Mayhem!!  is 2-Player-only and local-only . It supports gamepads but it can also be played with two players on one keyboard. Try the demo to find out if your keyboard supports shared keyboard. To play online with a friend you can use Remote Play Together.
row.short_description: A goofy, competitive two-player showdown perfect for killing time (and your buddy’s pride) while waiting for the pizza to arrive.

row.name: BrainRot
row.detailed_description: Compete against your friends to in a series of brainrot related minigames to become the brainrot champ. This is a casual party game based on popular brainrot trends and memes.  A lobby can host up to 16 players There are currently 4 game modes Each minigame has it's own unique challenge related to the meme the minigame is based off. Players earn brainrot in various ways each minigame. The player with the most brainrot at the end of all the minigames WIN! WARNING: Play at own risk, may cause serious brainrot.
row.short_description: A party pvp game based on brainrot trends.

row.name: Palette Cleanser
row.detailed_description: A whimsical and lively garden somewhere in the distant future gets invaded by color-slurping aliens and ends up completely desaturated. The garden robot is on a mission to cleanse the aliens of their gluttony and restore the color palette.    Palette Cleanser is a sweet, compact 3D platformer lovingly crafted by students from Breda University of Applied Sciences over the course of eight months.  Swiftly dash and jump around the level controlling an adorable robot, cleansing critters along the way to keep your speed up and your spirits high!                          These cheeky little aliens think they've taken over, but not for long! Collect them and bring them to safety of their own silliness.  But watch out, some might fight back...                          Experience a playful twist on size as a tiny robot exploring a HUGE garden! Wander in an open-ended environment and watch the world around you spring back to color as you progress!                          Anything else? Well, the development team couldn't figure out if the player is: slurp & sliding, dash & riding, zip & zapping, jump & pumping, boot & scooting, hop & bopping, surf & turfing, smooch & smacking, blink & skipping, boom & zooming, Plink & Plonk™-ing, but in any case you go very fast, so how about you just go and figure out and tell us later in the reviews.
row.short_description: Jump, dash and slide through a futuristic garden in Palette Cleanser, cute 3D platformer focused on smooth movement and an optimistic vibe! Control a tiny robot trying to restore the color palette of its garden. Capture the alien invaders to activate paint sprinklers and make the garden alive again.

row.name: The Final Print
row.detailed_description: In Development Take the role of an investigative journalist in Harlem, in the early 1940s. Someone has been murdered, and the explanations that the police have come up with just don't add up. Furthermore, the person that the police are accusing of the murder is a good friend of yours, so you'll do anything you can to find out the truth. Take Pictures Use your camera to collect evidence; take pictures of anything that seems important to the case. Organize Evidence See the evidence you collected in your journal, where you can organize and look at the pictures. Gather Clues Talk to people to try and find out what they know. But be careful, some might try to lie to you, and hide the truth. Get their testimonies and piece together the real story Solve the Case Build your case in the article and publish it to expose the true killer.
row.short_description: You're a journalist investigating a suspicious case during the Harlem riots. Take pictures of evidence, gather information by interrogating people, and put it all together in an article to show people the truth.
row.notes: This game contains depictions of the aftermath of violent crimes. The game consists of solving those crimes, and finding the culprit, cause of death, motive etc. This content is part of the main story and is unavoidable.

row.name: Katharsi
row.detailed_description: Explore the depths of the cathedral on your mission to eradicate the plague in this puzzle adventure game. Make your way towards the final chamber as you uncover the mysteries behind your companion and the cathedral around you.  Key Features  Explore a Byzantine era cathedral which has been corrupted by the plague   Solve light-based puzzles and use the light to cleanse the cathedral   Work together with your companion to overcome obstacles  Reveal the truth behind the plague and your companion  About the Development Team  This game is being developed by a team of 15 third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences. The game will fully release in June. After the game's final update, this game will no longer be supported by the developers.
row.short_description: Katharsi is a puzzle adventure set in a corrupted Byzantine cathedral. With the help of your companion, cleanse and illuminate the path in front of you by harnessing the power of the light. Solve the puzzles that block your path and reveal the truth behind this story.

row.name: Break-a-Bot
row.detailed_description: Fast-Paced Roguelike Action Engage in electrifying high-speed combat that combines dynamic attacks and over the top, slapstick violence. With each run, adapt and evolve your playstyle as you discover new part combinations and upgrades to dominate increasingly tougher foes. Key Features Unique Part-Swapping System: Customize Zippy with scavenged body parts, unlocking endless possibilities for strategy and playstyle. Fast-Paced Combat: Dive into frantic, skill-based battles where every decision and every part counts. Dynamic Progression: Each run offers new challenges, upgrades, and surprises ensuring no two fights are ever the same.
row.short_description: Defend your spaceship in Break-a-Bot, a vibrant roguelike where you battle cyborg raiders and customize your playstyle by scavenging enemy parts. Swap body parts in fast-paced combat to adapt and survive. Protect your home and become the galaxy’s most fearsome little robot!

row.name: Umbra Mortis
row.detailed_description: Rise up to your duty raven, foul magic has overtaken the beautiful city of Venice. We cannot let this stand. Venice must be purged. You will be tasked with going through the streets of the accursed city and erasing all that reeks of undeath. Serve well. The streets are full of them, for the carnival was taking place. Pay no heed to the enemy's numbers, for you will prevail. An odious miasma hangs in the air and has transformed all the celebrators into mindless husks of what they once were, free them from this hell so that the city can live on and grow old. Your task will take you all the way to the church, where you must call the horde upon yourself and deliver our god's fury to them. The subjects of your divine violence will be tenacious and maddened with starvation, you must never let your guard down. Through the possession, their bodies have deformed beyond recognition. Beware of the large ones and the partially disolved especially. This foul magic has made them resilient and formidable. It will be a battle hard-fought. But be not afraid for you are well equipped. You have at your disposal our finest weapons. The rifles we give you have been infused with prayer and the good will of our Lord, their bullets sear wicked flesh and purge evil souls. Our explosives carry in them the ashes of great saints, they tear skin and bone alike. But most of all, we give you a blessed artifact, one passed down through our organization. It heals the wounds of the righteous and brutalizes any heretic in its way. We wish you good luck warriors, may the light guide thee well. This game is a 3 player coop PvE shooter where you play as members of a secret organization, Umbra Mortis. You will go through the city of Venice which is overrun by undead carnival-goers.
row.short_description: Rise children of the almighty and be guided to your salvation. You must trek a path of mud and blood, but if you walk it together, you will surely have enough strength to tear through these beasts. Grab two friends and shoot zombies in this Venice carnival inspired shooter.
row.notes: This is a game about shooting guns with bullets at zombie-like enemies, that's the violence that you're gonna be seeing, gunshots and blood VFX, with the occasional explosion from a grenade on top of that.

row.name: Oh, Bugger!
row.detailed_description: Oh, Bugger! is a single-player first-person shooter where you take on the role of a mech pilot on a mission to reclaim a luxury hotel overrun by an alien infestation. Set in a retro-futuristic hotel, the game combines intense combat, mech upgrades, and a visually striking environment to deliver a thrilling experience. Key Features Mech Combat: You are controlling a big mech suit with a massive mini-gun that can transform into a shotgun! With it, you mow down hordes of relentless aliens. Experience adrenaline-fueled action with satisfying gunplay and explosive effects. Customization: Upgrade the abilities that your mech has. Tailor your playstyle to dominate the battlefield. Retro-Futuristic Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning environment inspired by retro-futuristic sci-fi designs. From the posh lobby of the hotel to the eerie glow of alien nests – every detail enhances the atmosphere. Challenging Enemy Types: Face different alien threats, each one with unique behaviors. Strategize your approach to overcome every threat you face! Endless Mode: Explore the ship room by room in a new survival mode - face unending waves of aliens and see how long you can last! Unlock it after completing the campaign. About the Development Team Developed by third-year students at Breda University of Applied Sciences, Oh, Bugger! delivers intense action, strategic mech customization, and a uniquely stylized space environment for an unforgettable gaming experience.
row.short_description: ‘Oh, Bugger!’ is a first-person shooter set in a luxury space hotel overrun by alien hordes. As a professional alien exterminator, pilot your mech to blast aliens and destroy their eggs, ending the infestation for good!
row.notes: Graphic violence such as exploding of aliens.

row.name: DREADTOME
row.detailed_description: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this Action-Adventure FPS. DREADTOME is a short game made by a team of third-year university students. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Use your repulser, firearm, and environmental hazards in strategic ways to dispatch the corrupted creatures that roam the library. Overcome trials of the mind in order to upgrade your tools. Explore the labyrinthian library to replenish resources and uncover the story that unfolded before your arrival. Battle varying enemy types, each with their own unique dangers.
row.short_description: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.

row.name: Blightspire
row.detailed_description: Blightspire is a fast-paced, wave-based survival shooter. Battle through a cursed graveyard as undead abominations rise in endless waves. With only your reflexes and firepower, survive the darkness in a world where death is never the end. In a plague-stricken 17th-century, you’re a thief drawn to rumors of treasure buried in a cursed cemetery. As you rob the graves, the dead rise to defend what’s theirs. Fighting to survive, you uncover a demonic presence seeping from an ancient church altar, its influence twisting the dead and spreading corruption. Now, it’s not just about gold... it’s about stopping hell from breaking loose. Survive relentless waves of the undead as the Black Death twists the once-living into monstrous horrors. Dodge, dash, and leap through plague-ridden graveyards to avoid the infected swarms Use your trusty revolver to blast through the twisted remains of humanity Stay alive, and uncover the dark forces fueling the nightmare The deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Loot the fallen dead to fund powerful relics from a demonic source Absorb their lingering souls to restore your health and keep fighting Take advantage of the demonic presence in the graveyard and use the unholy relics to your advantage.
row.short_description: Blightspire is a fast-paced, wave-based survival shooter. Battle through a cursed graveyard as undead abominations rise in endless waves. With only your reflexes and firepower, survive the darkness in a world where death is never the end.

row.name: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser
row.detailed_description: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is the prologue version of the full game Kitchen Wars . The Appetiser version is just a 60-minute gameplay of the full game. Serve your clients: Quickly prepare and deliver meals to keep customers happy. Purchase upgrades and items: Improve your kitchen, unlock boosters, and get the edge on your opponent. Attack the opposing restaurant: Use melee weapons to disrupt your rival's operations and steal their resources. Steal chairs: Sabotage the other restaurant by swiping their chairs, reducing their seating capacity. Upgrade your restaurant: Earn money from satisfied clients to invest in your kitchen and improve your chances of winning. Local Multiplayer Online Multiplayer Steam Remote Play
row.short_description: Kitchen Wars: Appetiser is the limited first taste of a fast-paced party game with 2-8 players that plunge players into the chaos of a restaurant, where they must engage in strategic fights and theft while catering to their clients.

row.name: Dice Making Ending
row.detailed_description: 🎲 Does Rolling the Dice Decide a Person's Ending? Dice Making Ending is a casual game designed to answer three questions you might have: Can life be determined by rolling a die? What if a game had no gameplay—only endings, like watching internet shorts? Would it still be fun? What kind of ending do I truly want? Features: Quick Play: While rolling the dice, you can experience the game at a fast pace. Anyone can enjoy it casually without pressure. Multiple Endings: Just like the many faces of a die, explore a variety of episodes and endings. A single person’s life can lead to countless possibilities—discover them all. Your Choice: What will your choice be? Ask yourself and find out. About the Developer bluestruggle is a one-person indie game development team creating games as a hobby. Making games is fun, but it also comes with its fair share of struggles. To all indie game developers out there—stay healthy and keep going! You got this! 💙✨
row.short_description: Does rolling the dice determine a person's ending?At every crossroad, we've all wondered about this at least once.Enjoy a casual game where you roll the dice and watch endings unfold.You can play various endings in just a short amount of time.

row.name: Champi
row.detailed_description: Prepare to defend your village in Champi, a captivating Tower-Defense where your mission is to repel an invasion of mutated mushrooms. Faced with the threat of a mycelian abomination, every strategic decision counts to protect your territory. With immersive graphics and challenges, Champi immerses you in a world where survival depends on your ability to eradicate this fungal threat. Each game is unique and depends on your strategic choices. Try, Learn, and try again ! 12 Turrets 29 Passives 10 Unique enemies 1 Map More content coming soon ! Enjoy !
row.short_description: Prepare to defend your village in Champi, a captivating Tower-Defense where your mission is to repel a invasion of mutated mushrooms.

row.name: Scrollmapper
row.detailed_description: Scrollmapper is an innovative scripture analysis tool designed to create detailed cross-references for both canonical and apocryphal scriptures. It's primary purpose is to connect the canonical scriptures to the lost books such as the Book of Enoch. Built using Godot game engine, Scrollmapper offers a visually appealing and intuitive interface for exploring and analyzing scripture relationships. Scrollmapper Key Features: Scripture Mapping: Create and visualize complex relationships between scriptures using an advanced graphing method. Gephi Integration: Export cross-references to Gephi for deep analysis, allowing users to uncover intricate connections within the scriptures. Comprehensive Database: Pre-populated with 340,000 cross-references, enabling immediate exploration and analysis. Meta Editing: Attach custom metadata to individual verses for enhanced filtering and analysis. Book Importing and Reading: Import books directly from Scrollmapper databases on GitHub and read them within the app. Open Source: Scrollmapper is open-source, encouraging community contributions and continuous improvement. Whether you are a scholar, researcher, or simply someone interested in biblical studies, Scrollmapper provides the tools you need to delve deeper into the scriptures and discover new insights.
row.short_description: Scrollmapper is an open-source scripture analysis tool that creates detailed cross-references for canonical and apocryphal scriptures. It features advanced graphing, Gephi integration, and meta editing, allowing users to visualize and explore complex scripture relationships.

row.name: Crestfall
row.detailed_description: You have 60 seconds to set up your side of the board, then, the game begins Advance your way up the board, capturing territory Deploy your forces across a compact battlefield Attack and discover your opponent's pieces Unleash powerful supports to turn the tide of battle mid-game From air-striking your opponent's General to airlifting your Flag out of danger. Each piece has unique ranks and abilities letting you craft devious strategies to outmaneuver your opponent. Unlike traditional strategy games, you can continue deploying reinforcements throughout the match, adapting your tactics as your opponent's army is gradually revealed. Will you play it safe and defend, or risk it all on an aggressive push to capture the enemy's flag?
row.short_description: Jebait your way to victory in this turn-based game of capture the flag. All board pieces are hidden at the start and you must capture territory, deploy pieces and use special abilities to outmaneuver your opponent. Bluff, bait and blunder your way to glory.

row.name: What The Hack!
row.detailed_description: What The Hack! Is a humoristic, story puzzle game, where you, a computer program, tries to avoid getting destroyed by escaping a facility. Doing so by hacking and hijacking devices in your surroundings. You play as Boolian, a facility worker whose consciousness is unexpectedly zapped into a computer. Before you can even process what’s happened, a security drone begins checking for malware. With no time to waste, you tap into your newfound hacking abilities, taking control of various machines to escape, like a drone, a robot vacuum, or even a towering logistics crane as you maneuver through the facility. Embark on a thrilling adventure, outsmart the facility's defenses, and uncover creative ways to break free. But be careful—some of the robots you encounter might not be as friendly as they seem! Make use of the unique hacking mechanic, allowing you to traverse the level in creative ways. This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year in the bachelor Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium. The music was composed by Joshua Mas, student at the Royal Conservatoire of Ghent

row.name: Voice of the Ocean
row.detailed_description: You've just come into a world already in ruins. You don't know who you are, and there's no one to tell you. Perhaps you are the last of your kind. It’s up to you, and the strength of your voice and fins, to piece together the past. Sing the forgotten songs, and uncover the echoes of a sunken, broken civilization.   Voice of the Ocean is the beginning of a single-player adventure where you will have to sing and swim. You will be a newborn mermaid, diving through ruins and looking for pieces of a long lost mural.  In the game you will: Sing to a living, handcrafted soundtrack. Use your voice to navigate the depths. Sing the melodies of your lost civilization, brought to life through an original score composed exclusively for the game by Jaime Fenoy Aguilera. You will have to hit the correct pitch using your voice, to charm fishes, move objects and sing the songs of the mermaids. Explore an unique artistic atmosphere. Dive into a forgotten world beneath the waves, with a traditional oil painting style brought to 3D. Swim through a vivid, impressionistic seascapes, poisoned by an uncertain past. You will be able to swim through ruins, buildings and areas reclaimed by nature. Recover the fragments of a hidden legacy. Part of the story of your people lies scattered across the deep. Unstructured and half-buried in a world that has forgotten it. Find the audio logs and the lost mural to reconstruct the past.    This game was created over the course of 11 weeks by third-year bachelor students from Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment, with the invaluable contribution of our original soundtrack composer, Jaime Fenoy Aguilera as well as our animator Maxine Desmet. We would also like to extend our heartfelt thanks to our coordinators, Alex Vanden Abeele and Tristan Clarysse, for their support and trust in our vision.
row.short_description: Voice of the Ocean is a single-player adventure about a lost world, and the echoes of a forgotten past. Use your voice to sing ancient melodies and explore a world lost beneath the waves. Dive into the depths to uncover the power within your song and learn why you may be the last of your kind.

row.name: OpenCAGE
row.detailed_description: OpenCAGE is a community-created modding toolkit for Alien: Isolation which enables custom scripting, configuration, and content modification through graphical user interfaces. This powerful tookit opens up a whole world of possibilities including custom models, missions, weapons, behaviours, and maps - with more functionality being added and improved over time! Join the community on Discord to learn tips and tricks, and get help for your own project. What's included? When you first launch OpenCAGE, you'll be presented with five options: Edit Assets : A tool to import/export textures, models, UI, and animations Edit Configurations : A tool to modify a range of game configurations (including weapons, ammo, NPC viewcones and locomotion, player attributes, and more) Edit Cathode Scripts : A tool allowing full access to the game's scripting system (including level population, missions, characters, weapons, and more) Edit Behaviour Trees : A tool giving full access to every behaviour tree in the game Launch Game : Functionality to launch the game directly to a level with various optional extras (including Cinematic Tools, debug helpers, and more) There's also functionality for creating/managing/restoring backups of levels, and reverting configurations and behaviour trees. Additional recommended tools When you're importing/exporting content with OpenCAGE, the following tools are recommended for working with the files: JPEXS Flash Decompiler - for UI .GFX files NVidia Texture Tools Exporter - for texture .DDS files OpenCAGE is an open-source project developed by the community, and is in no way related to (or endorsed by) Creative Assembly or SEGA. Alien: Isolation is required to be purchased and installed to utilise the toolkit's functionality.
row.short_description: OpenCAGE is a community-created modding toolkit for Alien: Isolation which gives access to scripting, assets, configurations, and behaviour trees.

row.name: Mr. Photographer - Into The Light
row.detailed_description: Dive into the captivating world of 'Mr. Photographer - Into the Light' , an action-packed platformer where every moment challenges your wit, strategy, and skill. With no paywalls or in-game purchases, this is a pure test of talent, patience, and wisdom. Every game is a fresh start, and every adventure demands a unique approach. Are you ready to rise from an intern to a master photographer? From bounce cards to drones and event triggers, every piece you collect enhances your abilities and opens up new strategies. But be warned—there’s no save feature. Every game is a new adventure, with dynamic checkpoints you must activate using live-collected items. Fail to strategize, and you’ll start over. But plan wisely, and you’ll keep pushing forward. Your Drone: Friend or Foe? Meet your drone companion—a tool that can be as much a challenge as it is a helper. Colliding with it depletes your health and may even cost you a life. Yet, with the right collectable item, the remote , you can take control of your drone, turning it into a valuable ally. Jump on it to access hidden areas or solve complex platforming puzzles. However, just like real drones, it might get stuck behind obstacles, testing your patience and timing. Dynamic Gameplay Features Strategic Collectables : Gather unique items that enhance your gameplay and allow you to discover new paths and solutions. Checkpoints on Your Terms : Progress by activating checkpoints with collectables, but choose wisely to optimize your run. Variety and Challenge : Each playthrough is unique, requiring you to adapt your strategies and explore the full depth of the game’s mechanics. Skill-Based Design : Success depends on your creativity, skill, and the ability to think quickly under pressure. The Final Test: Into the Studio The ultimate goal? Reach the photography studio and prove your worth. Adjust your lighting, fine-tune your camera settings, and capture the perfect shots of a model. Submit your best photo to the game’s server, where players worldwide will vote on the top submissions. This is your moment to shine, to showcase not just your platforming prowess but also your artistic eye. Will your photo stand out above the rest? Why You’ll Love This Game Pure, Skill-Based Gameplay : No shortcuts, no pay-to-win mechanics—just your ingenuity and determination. Fast-Paced Action Meets Creative Challenge : Combine quick reflexes with strategic thinking and artistic expression. Endless Replayability : With no saves and unique runs every time, each game offers a fresh experience. Community Engagement : Compete with players worldwide in the photography challenge and see how your skills stack up. Rise to the challenge. Unleash your creativity. And become the master photographer you were destined to be.

But beneath its unassuming storefront lies a deeper mystery. Rumored to be a covert training ground, its secrets are yours to uncover—if you can find a way inside. From behind the gates of the parking lot, behold the bustling city streets, where random passersby roam and cars cruise through the fog-drenched night, bringing the world to life. Parking Lot Dwellers The characters strolling in Hobbe’s Parking Lot may seem friendly —until you give them a reason not to be. From the casual citizens to the sharp-eyed security guard and the deadly Gunslinger, there’s plenty to deal with. Enjoy their quirky lines and bold personalities, but don’t get too close—the Sharpshooter isn’t one to miss. The Derelict Gate A shadowy fence stands tall beside Hobbe’s Gun Shop, locked tight and long forgotten by the bustling city around it. Its origins are unclear, but those with ambition and resourcefulness seem to have claimed the area for their own pursuits. What secrets lie behind the gate? Perhaps the answer isn’t what you expect—but those willing to explore might just uncover the tools they need to make progress. Gear up and dive in—will you uncover the secret behind Hobbe’s Gun Shop?
row.short_description: A low-poly first-person shooter with challenging combat, realistic bullet-drop physics, and cartoony characters. Navigate a foggy urban lot, solve puzzles to uncover secrets, and face quirky foes with bold personalities. Can you crack the mystery of Hobbe’s Gun Shop?
row.notes: This game features physical and gun violence, including melee combat and ranged attacks. Players can engage in fistfights, use melee weapons such as rocks, knives, and grenades, or shoot enemies with firearms. When struck, enemies may stumble and react with pain or collapse into ragdoll physics upon death. Firearm impacts result in blood spray effects and bloody bullet holes, but there is no intense gore—no dismemberment, blood puddles, or smears. Explosions from grenades also cause harm to characters. The game includes mild profanity such as "dammit" and "hell," but no explicit language. There is no sexual content. A "Healing Syringe" item is used to restore health through an injection animation, though this is not explicitly identified as a drug in the game.

row.name: Xalos Conquest
row.detailed_description: Imagine a reality where strange metallic beings suddenly fall from the sky with strange deadly weapons, and all you can defend yourself with are swords and bows. This unknown and powerful threat is something Egypt and the Roman Empire must soon face. Our adventure begins as Xalos, a Venishien war machine! Where sci-fi meets medieval, experience a epic clash between Xalos, Cleopatra, and Caesar in a top-down side-scroller. Play as Xalos as you charge into combat and summoning your robot army as you duke it out against the mighty soldiers of Egypt and Rome!  Featuring: 3 main gameplay levels 2 classes and upgrades to choose from high quality voice acting cutscenes with voice acting dialogue The goal of this is to bring a short but memorable experience as you play in a spare hour or lunch break.
row.short_description: Awaken my Xalos, the Venishien Empire calls for you! Conquer Earth against the Egyptians and Romans with our robotic might. As Sci-Fi meets Medieval in a epic top-down side-scroller war!

row.name: CSC
row.detailed_description: CSC is a simple platformer game where your small, square friend must dodge enemies and obstacles to reach the green substance. This game is so tiny that it’s almost hard to see, which is part of its charm. By default, the game’s resolution is extremely low. If you start the game and are greeted by a screen as tiny as a speck of dust, don’t worry—that’s completely normal. Test your skills in this amazing game! Controls Move : A, D Jump : Spacebar Tips If you want to make this game a bit easier and more playful, try lowering your computer’s resolution for a better experience.
row.short_description: Challenge yourself in this tiny and incredible game!

row.short_description: A reimagining of the classic Rock-Paper-Scissors to make it more competitive and engaging. Collect the cards and boost your score by facing increasingly stronger opponents.

row.name: FleshBound
row.detailed_description: FleshBound is a fast paced and blood pumping demon-slaying speed running action platformer with a unique “splatterpunk” aesthetic. Traverse unique and dangerous environments by utilizing abilities like dash, wall-run and grapple.  Explore the environment vertically through launchpads and see the world from a different perspective through the gravity inverters. Slay vile demons all along the way.  You play as Endo, a human incarcerated inside the fleshy walls of a living prison in hell, the Manifold. The sentence is harsh: be cocooned in place and slowly morph into a demon. One day a parasite attaches itself to Endo and begins communicating with him, offering a chance to escape his prison. Run! Key Features 15-20 minutes of playtime with high replayability A first person action runner in an organic-looking hellscape environment Dynamic traversal through grappling hook, wall run, jump pad, and gravity inversion mechanics A minimalistic gameplay UI A unique intense aesthetic inspired by punk, horror, comics, and older first person shooters A high intensity industrial metal and techno soundtrack Where did the game come from? FleshBound was developed during a 7 week project at FutureGames. Taking inspiration from games like Mirror's Edge , Ghostrunner , and Doom , we sought a fast, simple game loop where the challenge lies in mastering the balance between maintaining speed and control. Leaning heavily on the design pillars of 'Velocity, Visuals and Viscera', we quickly formulated the concept and with a visual style we can only describe as 'Splatterpunk', the vision of the game was easily communicated both within the team and with external stakeholders. row.short_description: FleshBound is a fast paced and blood pumping demon-slaying speed running first person action platformer with a unique “splatterpunk” aesthetic. Fight, jump and sprint your way through the levels using your hookshot and wall-running skills.

row.short_description: Embark on a moldy adventure in a land of bread. Play as Bradley the Breadapus, a waffle-tailed bread platypus, in this quirky action platformer and battle to cleanse a world infected by mold. Break the mold, save the world!

row.name: Kimochii Classroom
row.detailed_description: Hi hi~! This is Akemi signing on! Welcome to my new game, Kimochii Classroom! A free, slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Filled to the brim with personality, Kimochii Classroom offers a loveable cast of characters and a meticulously crafted soundscape to bring the world to life! You will follow Simon, a second-year high school student, and his day-to-day life with his friends, coworkers, and little sister. Every day Simon goes to school, works at his secret part-time job, and studies at home with his best friend Anna. Everything seems normal until Simon comes across a strange object that belongs to his classmate, Felicia. He doesn't know it yet, but he's stumbled into something much more complicated than he realizes. Get to know the characters! Annabelle - Annabelle, or 'Anna,' is Simon's best friend, and a classmate of his in class 201. Her outgoing and cheeky personality keeps Simon on his toes, and makes every day enjoyable! Anna is also super close with Chiko, so much so that many people think they're sisters! Chiko - Chiko is Simon's little sister! She may be small, but she packs enough energy for everyone around her! On top of her already immaculate cooking skills, Chiko is practicing hard every day to become an amazing singer and guitar player at her school's light music club! Felicia - Felicia is another member of class 201 with Simon. She's known for her stunning looks and perfect grades, but Felicia is also known for being the heiress to the Arison corporation, a massive company with lots of influence! row.short_description: Welcome to Kimochii Classroom! A slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Who will you meet first?

row.name: Telepath of Evil

row.name: Rabolut: Escape From Hell
row.detailed_description: RABOLUT: Escape From Hell  is a 2D pixel art game where you escape crises born in a toxic workplace. With semi-randomized maps and an increasing variety of traps as you progress, players must master movement techniques and carefully plan the use of limited resources to survive. row.name: Confluence: An Of Sense and Soul Soliloquy
