In the epilogue of his happy ending, Hugo waxes poetic on the scale of his life and love and how, wondrously, the littlest of things can also be the most precious. About A short kinetic novel spin-off from Forsythia Productions' Of Sense and Soul , a Queer Victorian Romance Visual Novel.  Confluence  was created during the O2A2 (Only One of Any Asset) VN Game Jam: Queer Edition 2023 . Features An emotional reflection on personal growth through love and change. 8-15 minutes of playtime Full voice acting One sprite, one soundtrack, and one background Dynamic cinematography and effects Gay thoughts 🌈 💭✨ English with Japanese Localisation Content & Spoiler Warnings Confluence  takes place after the events of  Of Sense and Soul , and contains vague references to the best ending in which Hugo and Seamus are in a relationship.  No OSAS plot events are detailed in Confluence, and you can still enjoy this without knowing the main story. Rated G.  Motion: Animations for a rotating background and cinematography are used. References The Ugly Duckling by Hans Christian Andersen.  Major themes include queer belonging, change, personal growth, and hope.
row.short_description: A poet ponders queer life and love after his happily ever after.

row.name: Couple Maker
row.detailed_description: Overview This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female. Strong Puzzle Elements We have prepared a total of 76 levels, ranging from easy to difficult. Each level has a specific number of characters, their arrangement, and the number and types of panels. The level is cleared when all the characters on the field are paired up. Each level has been designed with a focus on making the puzzle-solving experience enjoyable. Instead of simply increasing the number of similar levels to inflate the game's volume, we have adjusted the levels to ensure that each one offers a unique and engaging challenge. While the time it takes to clear all the levels may vary depending on the player, it is estimated that it will take around 10 hours to complete all levels. Support for Various Genders By default, the game pairs boys and girls together, but you can change this setting from the options menu to allow for same-gender pairings, such as boys with boys or girls with girls. Additionally, there are more detailed settings available for further customization. Story The protagonist is a woman in pajamas, as seen in the main visual. Her profession is a romance novel writer. When brainstorming ideas for her stories, she never skips a mental simulation. In her mind, she creates couples, has them converse, go on dates, and be affectionate with each other, using these imagined scenarios to expand her story ideas. This game, a puzzle about creating couples, is a representation of her daydreams (or rather, her job to earn a living). Let's try playing on a smartphone or tablet With the Remote Play feature, you can play this game on your smartphone or tablet. Instead of using arrow keys or ABXY buttons, you can control the game with just taps and drags. Every once in a while, why not take a break from your computer and relax in bed, playing on your smartphone? Streaming Policy Play videos and screenshots of 'Couple Maker' can be used on SNS, blogs, and video posting sites as long as they do not violate public order and morals or laws. Feel free to monetize it. Please keep promoting it!
row.short_description: This is a puzzle game where you create couples. Place panels with various effects on a 3x3 grid and help two people in love meet. You can freely choose the combination of couples, such as male-female, male-male, or female-female.

row.name: Symphone
row.detailed_description: Symphone is a platformer set in a once-vibrant world now consumed by a mysterious force known as 'The Silence.' This dark power steals the voices of the creatures of Symphone, turning them into lost souls wandering aimlessly. Play as Euphony, a unique bunny without a voice, on a quest to collect these souls and restore the music and light that once filled the forest. Journey through a desolate, bioluminescent world, overcoming obstacles, and dodging threats to free the souls trapped by 'The Silence.' Each soul you collect brings Euphony closer to completing the final symphony, a powerful melody capable of banishing the darkness once and for all. Key Features: Platforming Action – Jump, dodge, and explore a beautiful yet haunting forest. Emotional Story – Experience a touching narrative about loss, restoration, and hope. Atmospheric Music – Enjoy a captivating soundtrack that follows you throughout the world. Bioluminescent World – Stunning visual style with glowing environments that come to life as you restore balance. Challenging Obstacles – Face environmental challenges and enemies in your journey to save the world from The Silence. Help Euphony restore harmony to Symphone and bring light back to her world. Will you be the one to end The Silence?
row.short_description: Symphone is a narrative platformer where you play as Euphony, a voiceless bunny, who must collect lost souls, overcome obstacles, and bring light and harmony back to her world.

row.name: Espresso Economics
row.detailed_description: Coffee shop management game that teaches economics Manage your own coffee shop and make money. During the day you serve orders at your coffee shop, during the night you manage it using economics principles like demand and supply curves, labour market, externalities etc. Game has 3 levels of cafes, variety of coffee types and a lot of mechanics to manage your shop.
row.short_description: Coffee shop management game that teaches economics. Manage your own coffee shop and make money. During the day you serve orders at your coffee shop, during the night you manage it using economics principles like demand and supply curves, labour market, externalities etc.

row.name: The Pancake Paradox
row.short_description: The story of two women, who make pancakes in the middle of a sandstorm, even though the planet is dying. is a bit short, right? ...then a story that has a little more than that.
row.notes: This game contains moderate level of(age rating 15~17ish) violent scenes and scripts. Swearing and uncensored violent language included. It is not intended to be labelled as an adult only content, though unrecommended to minors.

row.name: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective
row.detailed_description: 🧩 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is digital cross-stitch . A meditative game about completing a single enormous  60,000 piece grid puzzle. 🖼️ In this entry   in the Mega Mosaic series, you'll slowly reveal a pixel art collage of major news events from the last year, ranging from politics to sport, climate change to pop culture. 💣 If you’re familiar with minesweeper, you’re ready to dive in! Use the numbered clues (0-9) to uncover light tiles that gradually reveal an intricate, detailed mosaic. 🎶 Whether you're engrossed in your favourite podcasts or listening to your favourite tunes, 2024: Mosaic Retrospective serves as the perfect backdrop to enhance your experience. Or choose from the soothing built-in soundtrack. ⏳ Dozens of Hours of Addictive Gameplay!  2024: Mosaic Retrospective offers hours of meditative, yet challenging gameplay as you piece together the events that shaped the year. If you like this free game, please consider supporting the UNICEF fundraiser that the game is supporting! You can find the link to the fundraiser in the settings menu within the game.
row.short_description: 2024: Mosaic Retrospective is a charity-fundraising picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring a single ENORMOUS puzzle inspired by global news stories from throughout the year.

row.name: Wild Snap
row.detailed_description: [This game will retire in november 2025, the store page won't be listed anymore] Wild Snap is a relaxing short puzzle game about finding creative, strange and logical ways to attract animals and take pictures of them. Some animals are easy to catch with a simple bait, while others require more serious thinking. The animals must be alone in the frame for the picture to be valid. You’ll have access to some mysterious tools, including a shell, a do-over, a time-rewinder, a fire lantern, a love potion, a magnifier, some cutlery, a magic eraser, and an inverter (whatever that means). There are 8 levels to complete and 68 animals to photograph. Good luck!
row.short_description: Wild Snap is a relaxing short puzzle game about finding creative, strange and logical ways to attract animals and take pictures of them.

row.name: ReSpaced
row.detailed_description: Step into the role of Proband 027, a test subject fighting for survival aboard a space station overrun by hostile entities. Your goal? Escape the station by clearing each room, while mastering unique mechanics that turn your gun into more than just a weapon. Battle Through Enemy-Infested Rooms! Face a relentless horde of threats determined to stop you at every turn. Your goal is simple: eliminate every enemy to unlock the safety doors and advance. But be ready... Each room introduces new challenges and enemy types that demand strategy, speed, and quick reflexes. Turn Recoil Into Power! Your gun isn’t just for shooting, it’s your key to mobility. The gun’s powerful recoil can launch you to hard-to-reach platforms or propel you away from danger. Master this unique mechanic to gain the upper hand and navigate the station in ways no normal jump could ever achieve. Upgrade and Adapt! Clearing the room unlocks the upgrade machine, where you can modify your weapon. Want faster reloads? Do more damage? Customize your gun to suit your playstyle, but beware, some upgrades comes with trade-offs. Choose wisely to prepare for the increasingly difficult challenges ahead. Survive. Adapt. Escape. Re:Spaced is an intense experience where every shot counts, every upgrade matters, and every room brings you closer to freedom. Do you have what it takes to make it out alive?
row.short_description: A fast-paced first-person shooter where you master gun recoil to leap across platforms, battle various enemies, and upgrade your weapon to escape an overrun space station.

row.name: The Nutcracker of Riepass (Nymph's Tale ep 2)
row.detailed_description: A YA fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with turn-based jrpg battles. Part 2 of the Nymph's Tale series, but can also be played as a standalone. Story rich with (skippable) battles between the scenes and optional minigames. FEATURES: -epic adventure, comedy and romance -custom anime art -beautiful pixel art maps -battles where you can affect how difficult you want them to be with optional items -4 characters with unique skills and strategy -optional minigames -total playtime 2-3 hours The gameplay consist of cutscenes that advance the story and a number of fights between them. The battles feature an ATB-wait turned based system and offer challenging adversaries. The difficulty can be adjusted by choosing to use optional items. All the battles can be skipped if you just want to follow the story. A young man embarks on a quest to find the woman of his dreams, but instead runs into the woman's angry little sister. Together they must travel the hostile frozen wastes to reach the home city of the mysterious race living in the mountains. The route is filled with terrible monsters, but are the monsters really what the young man should be fearing? Adventure awaits in the frozen mountain lands!
row.short_description: A fantasy comedy hybrid visual novel with jrpg battles
row.notes: Swearing, fantasy violence. A couple of scenes that relate to sexual themes.

row.name: Nephilim
row.detailed_description: Nephilim is a student-made isometric combat and exploration game set in a dying fantasy land. As Strider Lazarus, you'll learn to master both Light and Shadow to vanquish the foes standing in your path. Switch between the Light and the Dark worlds to empower your abilities, get over obstacles and solve puzzles.  Fight Angels and Demons alike using all the tools in your arsenal! You'll need to master everything to defeat the game's many bosses. Fast and Charged attacks Special unlockable combos Powerful Light and Dark Ultimate Abilities Holy Sword Summon Speed is of the essence. Move quickly to evade attacks, Health Potions can run out quick! Keep your eyes peeled for Upgrade Gems. Each one takes you one step closer to being to ultimate warrior. Invest them at Bonfires to increase Strider Lazarus' stats and to unlock new combos, attacks and special abilities! Nephilim was made over 4 months by a team of six developers and features an original soundtrack by Nerveight .
row.short_description: Battle Angels and Demons alike as Strider Lazarus -  a fighter born again to master Darkness and Light - in this student-made isometric combat game.

row.name: IdeaBookRoom
row.detailed_description: The Idea Bookroom is a new writing and reading platform, characterized by supporting various interesting interactive reading components, which can greatly enrich readers' reading experience. The official website ( ideabookroom dot com ) offers an Android version APK / Web version. Multiple reading components, bid farewell to boring pure text reading ~~~ Component 1: StartPS and EndPS StartPS = The author can say two sentences before each chapter     EndPS =  The author can say two sentences at the end of each chapter Component 2: Image Conventional image component, click to enter browsing, slide down to exit   Component 3: Narrator Narrator is a type of centered card text, inspired by the dramatic novel (Narrator: XXXXXX）。 Optional text color and bottom color, with multiple preset colors to choose from. Can be displayed in multiple rows. The author can use the sidebar to prompt the time, place, background, and content of relatively 'non plot scenes' such as comments and roast.   Component 4: ShowText ShowText is an interesting (!!!) interactive component that hides text and image in clickable glowing text. When readers click, a surprise will pop up! Click on the glowing text to bring up the text and image! Click on the glowing text to bring up the image! Component 5: FloatingNotes FloatingNotes are highly expandable folded text segments that can be used to fold 'parsing', 'translation', 'comments', etc. They also support custom float tags. Click to expand or switch.   Component 6: Link Link  component makes your book no longer just a book. 1. It can link to online books and automatically display the cover, title, and introduction. Click to jump to the corresponding book's detail page. 2. Preset icons and connection forms of commonly used applications. row.short_description: The IdeaBookRoom is a writing and reading software that goes beyond plain text by incorporating multimedia and interactive components such as 'Narrator,' 'Image', 'ShowText', 'Words Before', and 'Words At End' significantly enhancing readers' experience.

row.name: Caveman hits Giraffe in a Car
row.detailed_description: Slash, survive and get tougher - a wacky action roguelike with hand-drawn graphics and a caveman on the hunt for monsters! Just when you think you've seen it all, here it comes: a giraffe in a car. Features: Fight against 5 unique, hand-drawn opponents with different abilities. The waves are randomly generated and follow a sophisticated difficulty system that pits you against increasingly more and tougher opponents. Improve your skills after each completed round and adapt them to your play style. Use powerful abilities to gain an advantage - whether you're escaping from tricky situations or planning the perfect attack. Too easy? Why does the caveman hit the giraffe in the car? The caveman doesn't like technology :(

You can also lead armed residents on traveling to different landscapes such as grassland, desert, snow, and volcanoes.

row.name: 东方异域见闻 ~ Touhou Dystopian Playtest
Knortex
row.detailed_description: 概要 『ノルテクス』は、主人公『苗広(なえひろ)』として箱庭の世界、『渦』を探索するアドベンチャーゲームです。 しかし渦は7日後に滅亡します。 限られた時間の中で渦を探索し、物資を漁り、住人たちとのイベントを進めながら、家に帰る方法を探しましょう。 探索 探索はマウス操作を中心に進行します。 場所を移動するたびに時間が経過し、苗広は疲労し、空腹や渇きを覚えます。 幸い、渦には様々な品が流れ着くため、スカベンジで物資を回収し、不足は住人との取引で補いましょう。 脅威 渦には『ハウンター』と呼ばれる怪物が巣食います。 彼らは常に苗広を探し、その命を脅かします。 視界を避け、時にはアイテムを駆使しながら、魔の手から逃れましょう。 交流 苗広は見知らぬ世界で突然目覚め、不安を抱えています。 住人たちとの交流は、孤独な探索とハウンターの脅威にすり減った苗広の心を癒やしてくれるでしょう。 彼らから寄せられる依頼を手助けすれば、報酬を得て探索に役立てることもできます。 さらに絆を深めていけば、渦の行く末にも影響を与えるかもしれません。 ※本作は過去に公開された同名のフリーゲームに、Steam実績および難易度選択機能を追加したバージョンです。
row.short_description: 起きたら別の世界にいた。しかも7日後、滅ぶらしい。 『ノルテクス』は、主人公「苗広」として箱庭の世界を探索するゲームです。 住人たちを助けたり、助けられたりしながら、家に帰ろう。
row.notes: Contains graphic violence and depictions of dead bodies

row.name: A Coloring Break
row.detailed_description: Here is a simple and relaxing coloring and doodling game, featuring many fun and cute patterns. You can freely fill them with colors and doodle however you like. row.name: 貢げ！女神様
row.detailed_description: This game is an Ogiri adventure game where you collect and carry items around the map and offer them to the goddess. Collect items and continue offering while paying attention to your budget and time limit. In the end, if you have a lot of ``emotion meter'', you will be happy with the goddess, but if you don't have a lot, you may get angry... row.short_description: 'Ogiri Adventure Game' is a quest to gather and donate items to please the Goddess. Find theme-based items highlighted in red, donate within the budget, and raise the emotion meter. A high meter brings joy, while a low one may cause anger. Keep trying!

row.name: Infinity R
row.detailed_description: Race through voxel tracks that go on forever, collecting regular item drops as you go—unless a toll or lack of fuel decides to slow you down. But don’t worry, you’re in control! Simply click to clear those annoying tolls or refuel your car when the gas light’s on. The faster you click, the sooner you get back on track, with those sweet drops just around the corner. No upgrades, no fancy power-ups—just you, your car, and the satisfaction of clicking your way through each obstacle. The car may slow down now and then, but who said you can’t have fun while waiting? Perfect for the IDLE player who loves a little challenge, a lot of clicks, and zero pressure. So, ready to fuel up and drive toward your next drop? Infinity R is waiting! Drop statistics: Start at 2KM, then increase by 1.6 times each successful drop Drop chances are 1 out of 12 from the game Every 10 successful drops, ratio start from the base again Common: 70%, Uncommon 19.9%, Rare 6.8%, Epic 2.8%,  Legendary 0.5% Maximum 20 drops per day, Minimum 2 Minutes of playtime required to receive drops
row.short_description: Welcome to Infinity R, an IDLE where the road is endless, the drops are regular, and the only thing standing between you and victory is... well, a bunch of pesky tolls and a never-ending fuel gauge!

row.name: Lightmatter Anniversary
row.detailed_description: Celebrate the 5-year anniversary of Lightmatter with us! Join us for a walk down memory lane with 9 playable Lightmatter prototypes — spanning from 2013 to 2018! From its early inception as a university project called 'See You On The Other Side', to the full Steam release in 2020, we want to give something back to the community by providing an exclusive peak into the many iterations that Lightmatter went through to see the light of day! Use lights and shadows to solve mind-bending puzzles Lightmatter is a 3D puzzle game where touching shadows is dangerous. Drawing inspiration from the classic first-person puzzlers, the gameplay revolves around utilizing lights to your advantage in order to solve mind-bending puzzles. As the prototypes demonstrate, we experimented with a lot of different gameplay mechanics about how to manipulate light in interesting ways. But the core goal was always the same: make the player experience the satisfying 'aha moment' by using lateral thinking. Play through a gallery of 9 prototypes and learn about the game's development Each of the prototypes tell the story of the many trials and tribulations we went through as an indie game studio in order to release our very first game on Steam. As a completely new team, we had to learn everything from scratch — including how to design puzzles, writing a story, running a business, and pitching to investors and publishers. See you on the other side! By scrolling through the game's menu and looking at the prototypes in chronological order, you will learn tidbits about how the gameplay evolved over time, how we managed to tell a sci-fi story, and how the game slowly found its identity. We hope you enjoy this little package of game development nostalgia as much as we did putting it together! <3
row.short_description: Join us for a walk down memory lane with never-before-released Lightmatter prototypes. Get a peak behind the game design curtains and learn how we made a first-person puzzle game about lights and shadows.

row.name: Eternal Night Glory
row.detailed_description: In the dark corners, there are all kinds of them, which seem to appear suddenly. Chasing the brilliance and delusionally wanting to be a creature that shines brightly. The Gate of Radiance is their goal. And you will command the garrisons of the Gate of Radiance to stop them from approaching. For you, it doesn't matter if you fail, you have countless chances to fail, and they don't have a chance to succeed. The gates of radiance have never been opened to them. In this game, from the very beginning, you have all the cards And you lose the sense of accomplishment of unlocking cards in the game The balance of the game is approximately equal to nothing Who loves to play this game !? Game content The game has more than 20 building cards (Light Cards) and more than 100 functional cards (Radiance Cards) Start At the beginning of the game, you need to choose the difficulty and the building card that will be used in the game. Light door In the part of the game, the colored rings, you need to stop any monsters from approaching the light door. Otherwise, if the light door is not durable enough, the game fails. Building Cards can only be placed inside the light door. Layout Building: Tower When placing building cards inside a light gate during a match, most buildings will automatically attack the enemy closest to the light door When you put a building, you need to consume one resource: the light. The light grows automatically over time. At this point, you'll need to choose the Radiance card you want to play to directly enhance your building, or synthesize/buy new cards to build your deck, etc. Victory Defended until the end of time.
row.short_description: From the beginning, you've got all the cards. Now, command the garrisons of the Gate of Radiance to stop them from approaching.

row.name: Physics World: Evolution
row.detailed_description: Enter the New World of Physics Welcome, Testers! Step into Physics World: Evolution,  the next-generation sandbox simulation where physics is your playground and curiosity is your guide. As the spiritual successor to 2023’s Physics Lab , this evolution delivers more tools, more locations, and a world layered with secrets waiting to be uncovered. New Tools. New Chaos. Push the limits of what’s possible using an expanded arsenal of physics tools and environmental objects. Launch explosives  or  detonate nukes . Shatter jars , rocks , and more with real-time physics interactions. Experiment freely across 5+ diverse testing labs , each with unique environments and potential outcomes. row.short_description: Push the limits of what’s possible with physics in Physics World: Evolution!

row.name: Atropos
row.detailed_description: For a long time, the kingdom of Capernaum has been ruled by the Khrushch dynasty - powerful beetles that rule over other insects. row.short_description: 'Atropos' is a visual novel in which you will learn about the story of Atropos, the prince of Capernaum.

row.name: Cards!

row.name: Only The Lost Shall See
row.detailed_description: This humble 3D platformer is about peace of mind. Wander though nature. Overcome dangers. Get to the end of your pilgrimage. You may find distractions that will lead you down a bad path. You may want to stay clear of those. Unless you want to get lost. If you are looking for elaborate game mechanics, options to unlock skins and huge boss battles - well then you have come to the wrong place. This game is simply a singleplayer platformer. You should play this game if you want a break from tactical gameplay - or if you want unravel the purpose of this game. The goal of this game is simple; get to the end. Only you can decide where exactly the end is.
row.short_description: Wander though nature. Overcome dangers. Get to the end of your pilgrimage... But don't dig any deeper.
row.notes: While this game contains no violence, it does contain images of drugs. It also contains the implication of suicide, as well as general psychological horror.

row.name: Frak
row.detailed_description: Frak is a fast-paced, movement-shooter, rogue-like that aims to immerse audiences with a simple gameplay loop. You play as an escaped employee trapped beneath the mines of a foreign planet attempting to escape against overwhelming odds the infected former coworkers of your facility. Will you survive, or you will you be trapped in the loop destined to cycle forever against unwavering forces? As a former worker, you will have access to maneuverability tech for traversing the mines. You will be able to wallrun and use your thrusters to dash through the air or boost around on the ground. The mines sought after a powerful material that gave those that wield it unique abilities. You can find these in each room designated by the doorways leading to different refinery sections. Collect the ancient material, grow stronger, and find a way to escape!
row.short_description: Frak is a fast-paced, movent shooter that is simply put a short rogue-like with charm.
row.notes: There is blood splatter during gameplay and it's stick onto the environment

row.name: Ryo And Gears
row.detailed_description: The game takes place in a world where machines roam the planet, where humans are rare to come by. Ryo is small humanoid robot tasked by its owner to retrieve six mythical circuits scattered across lands and seas. As Ryo's journey goes on, perhaps a truth unbeknownst will reveal itself, questioning the very purpose of Ryo's journey. Gameplay Fight a variety of foes divided into 5 chapters, each in a unique environment, most starting with easier enemies and ending with a boss. Ryo has but one hit point and a gearwheel , so be careful not to take two consecutive hits! Ryo fires highly pressurized four-way  steam cutters  to attack its enemies.
row.short_description: A 2D pixel-graphics bullet-hell with a last-chance shield mechanic

row.name: Sinew
row.detailed_description: Survive in a dark, biomechanical, aquatic world filled with danger around every corner. Hungry creatures lie in wait to devour you, lurking within the shadowy depths - waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike! Solve puzzles and swim through hazards. Try to stay alive! Features: Play as a biomechanical aquatic creature Use your abilities to solve puzzles and outwit enemies Environmental physics Controller support Use your boost to speed past dangerous enemies and push objects. Interact with various mechanisms to help solve puzzles and open passageways.
row.short_description: Venture into the mysterious, horrid depths of a cold and threatening abyss in this short, dark adventure game. Players assume control of a small, aquatic creature as they must avoid dangers and solve environmental puzzles.

row.name: VR Secretary: Ailey Edition
row.detailed_description: [Background] Congratulations on starting your CEO career! We’re here to teach you how to manage the relationship between you and your secretary. If you happen to experience anything else, well... that’s just your imagination running wild. [Game Feature] In VR Secretary , you will become a rookie CEO, managing not just the office, but also the subtle dynamics with your new secretary, Ailey. Here’s what awaits you: Immersive Roleplay: Take charge as a fresh CEO navigating a fully interactive VR office. From delegating tasks to sharing quiet moments after work, every scene brings you closer to the fine line between professionalism and personal connection. Dynamic Scenarios: From managing tasks in the office to sharing drinks after hours—every choice matters. High Interaction: Explore a variety of poses and enjoy the freedom to interact closely with your secretary, creating a highly immersive experience. [Tips] Before you begin the first day as a CEO, here are some practical tips to keep in mind: Tip 1 : Be polite and keep a professional distance! Tip 2 : Maintain proper social etiquette, even when drinking! Tip 3 : Once everything is organized, your career will reach the next level!  Prove you can stay cool, make the right calls, and survive the ultimate workplace challenge - if you can! Thank you for playing VR Secretary. We hope you enjoy every moment of your office journey!
row.short_description: VR Secretary puts you in a real office situation. You think you can handle anything, but the relationship with your secretary, Ailey? Cross the line, and your workplace journey might become unexpectedly “eventful”. Being a CEO may not be quite what you imagined.

row.name: Deep Siege
row.detailed_description: Deep Siege is a fast-paced, first-person endless wave shooter set in the depths of an underwater world. Step into the role of Akula, a fearless Atlantean warrior of sharkfolk descent, as you battle relentless hordes of mutated sea creatures threatening your home. Harness your Bloodthirst ability, which builds with kill streaks and features three tiers, granting different buffs or allowing you to heal yourself in the heat of battle.
row.short_description: Deep Siege is a fast-paced, first-person endless wave shooter. Play as Akula, an Atlantean sharkfolk warrior, and defend your underwater realm against waves of mutated sea creatures. Rack up kills to gain buffs using Bloodthirst or heal during tough moments.

row.name: Psi Academy: Orientation
row.detailed_description: PSI ACADEMY: ORIENTATION +85,000 Words! 16 Sprited Characters! 50+ Expressive Choices! Extremely Generic Backgrounds! It is the year 94AP, ninety-four years after the alien comet struck the earth and reset the calendar, causing psions (‘psionically-gifted children') to be born around the world. Only 2% of the population is found to have such superpowers at adolescence, so when the ages passed you by wherein such powers typically manifest themselves, you resigned yourself to a lifetime *without* the powers of a demigod. Until today. Psi Academy is a slow-burn slice-of-life dating sim exploring the mundane in the fantastic. Set in a magical/superhero academy, you’ll find yourself making lots of fun, expressive choices as you make new friends (and enemies) and choose to pursue one of three female leads: You’ll also meet plenty of other curious characters, such as faculty, family, and other psychic students. Psi Academy is an attempt to capture what we first imagined when we heard the word ‘dating sim’, and we hope it is as much fun to play as it was to write. 🙂 Psi Academy: Orientation is the first project of Playdate Studios, hopefully it attracts attention so more games like it can be developed!
row.short_description: Finding love in a psychic high school.

row.name: Call of Clans
row.detailed_description: Call of Clans is an online turn-based strategy card game set in a Western fantasy world. You can build a dynamic and strategic deck using minion cards and skill cards to challenge equally matched opponents in a world of swords and magic. You can also team up with other players to tackle highly challenging co-op dungeons. Game Features Deck Building : Players can construct their decks using minion cards and skill cards. Minion cards are categorized into Normal, Elite, and Hero. Normal cards can be deployed up to 2 copies, while others can only be deployed once. Each deck can contain up to 30 cards, including both minion and skill cards. Gameplay : Players battle on a 3x10 grid, taking turns to move until the opponent’s or their own commander is defeated. Classes : Players can freely choose between four classes: Knight, Mage, Priest, and Hunter. Each deck can only use cards from a single class. Ladder Competition : Once the Tiani Arena is unlocked, you can compete against other players in thrilling matches. The ladder is reset each season, and based on the players’ ranking points, top players will earn not only prestige but also generous seasonal rewards. Team Mode : After unlocking team dungeons, you can team up with other players to challenge high-difficulty dungeons. Dungeons come in three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal, and Hard. The higher the difficulty, the greater the rewards.
row.short_description: Call of Clans is an online turn-based strategy card game set in a magical world. Build a versatile deck with minion and skill cards to challenge equally matched opponents in a world of swords and magic. Team up with others to conquer challenging co-op dungeons

row.name: Ascent DX
row.detailed_description: Ascent DX is a tiny metroidvania brought to life in glorious 64 x 64 pixel art and soothing chiptune music. Crashed on an unknown planet you have to explore lush jungles, lifeless deserts, and luminescent caves in search of anything that can help you understand what has happened to the planet and how to get off it. While the game is a bigger version of the original Ascent, with almost twice as many locations to explore, it is still quite a short game. With the same celebrated gameplay and atmosphere, the DX versions also brings more items to find, more platforming puzzles, and more lore to uncover.  FEATURES A world brought to life by tiny but expressive pixel art Explore the planet's many biomes in your own pace and direction Find new powers and abilities that help you on your way Uncover the fate of the planet as well as your own  Different endings based on how much was discovered CREDITS Design, code, & pixel art: Johan Peitz Music & sfx: Brent Houston Capsule art: Jon Nielsen
row.short_description: Crashed on a desolate but mysterious planet you find yourself eye to eye with an ancient civilisation. Explore the planet, find powerful upgrades, and fulfill your destiny.
row.reviews: “Ascent DX is a wonderful showcase of how important good gameplay is and the fact that you don’t need ray tracing or the highest frame rate to have a strong gaming experience.” 4/5 – So Many Games

row.name: Wizard's quest: Reclaiming the realm Playtest
Our Winding Road
row.detailed_description: Disillusioned with civilian life, former heroes Rowan and Jori retrace the steps of the journey on which they fell in love, with the hopes of rekindling their strained relationship. Assume the role of the-great-“Ogre Slayer”-turned-desk-jockey Rowan, brave the various dangers lurking on your way, yourself being chief among them. Will you and your love find your way back together again, or will this journey mark the end for you two? Mature Warning: Contains explicit descriptions of sex. (Can be avoided via an in-game choice) -32k words -Multiple endings  -Animated sprites and backgrounds  -Immersive soundscape  -Enough puns to bring you to tears, or drown your sorrows, your choice A collaborative effort by Square Weasel Studio and friends, made for Amare Jam 2023. Game, Art & Story Direction:  Nim & Ze Environment Art:  Sarianne, Nim Sprites and Character Design: Rinnuah (with a little help from Nim & Ze) UI Design and Coding Support:  Ayael Writing and Editing: Nim & Ze, Brombeer Programming:  RodFireProductions Scripting: Nim & Ze Animation: Ze Sound Design: Nim & Ze Proofreading:  Rinnuah,  Brombeer,  Aetheries Music and Sound: Samuel Francis Johnson, Musictown, William King, MaxKoMusic, Scott Buckley, Alexander Nakarada, Check Out Square Weasel's Other Games: Chronicles of Taldun: The Remainder Chronicles of Taldun: The Longing
row.short_description: retired heroes-domestic-fantasy-breakup(?)-adventure
row.notes: Contains text-only descriptions of sexual intercourse. (Player can choose not engage in this activity, thus avoiding the text.)

row.name: Sewers Adventures
row.detailed_description: Dive into the twisted depths of Sewers Adventure , where science meets horror in an unforgettable mini-game experience. Step into the boots of a daring investigator unraveling the tragic story of a brilliant but reckless scientist who transformed the sewers into his sprawling secret laboratory. Driven by ambition, he created terrifying creatures—but his hubris led to his ultimate demise at the hands of his own experiments. Navigate claustrophobic tunnels, and survive encounters with grotesque monstrosities as you piece together the scientist's dark legacy. Will you escape the depths, or will you become another victim of his ill-fated ambition? Prepare to descend. The sewers await.
row.short_description: Dive into Sewers where you will find a secret lab filled with terrifying creatures. Face the horrors of a fallen scientist and try to escape his dark legacy. This project was conceived in the context of a Level Design programming course.

row.name: Cobble: The Stone Forager
row.detailed_description: When a group of shipwreck survivors wash up on the shores of a strange quiet island, the last thing they expected was a miracle. With no supplies and no idea where to get food, the settlers begin searching for help before stumbling across a sleeping stone automaton. When one brave settler takes a closer look, the stone giant awakens and offers to help the villagers build a home. Cobble: The Stone Forager is an adventure resource-gathering game where you play as the friendly stone giant, Cobble. Help the shipwrecked settlers build up their town by gathering and foraging for supplies. Unlock new areas and trade with the settlers to get stronger materials. Rediscover the story of Cobble's creator and rebuild what has been lost. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Gather resources and explore to help lost settlers build a new home in this relaxing, foraging RPG.

row.name: 灵剑奇缘
row.detailed_description: 《灵剑奇缘》is an epic MMORPG action xianxia (immortal-martial) game masterpiece, featuring stunning scenery, exquisite graphics, a prolonged storyline, and intricate romantic entanglements. With its mirage-like cityscapes and mist-covered sacred mountains, the game perfectly captures the essence of traditional Chinese aesthetics. Set against a grand backdrop and intertwined with intricate plots, it poignantly revisits the epic tales of xianxia heroes and heroines. 》》》》》Game Features《《《《《 Character Demonization System : After a character undergoes demonization, their combat power significantly increases, enabling more efficient monster-slaying. Transformation System : Upon awakening, characters can gain a substantial boost in combat power and attributes. Effortless Monster Slaying : Enjoy an ultra-satisfying experience as if cutting through grass. Romance System Arrives : Find your beloved him/her Exclusive Skills and Costumes for Characters : Make a dazzling debut with unique abilities and fashionable outfits.
row.short_description: 《灵剑奇缘》 is an epic MMORPG action xianxia (immortal-martial) game masterpiece, featuring stunning scenery, exquisite graphics, a prolonged storyline, and intricate romantic entanglements.

row.name: Jumping Henry
row.detailed_description: Jumping Henry is a fun and simple adventure game where you collect coins and jump your way through exciting challenges. Whether you're a casual gamer or someone looking for a relaxing experience, Jumping Henry provides a delightful and engaging journey for everyone. Jump, collect, and enjoy the ride!
row.short_description: Jump, collect coins, and enjoy a fun, easy adventure for players

row.name: Trolley Dash
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Trolley Dash , the frantic endless arcade shopping game where speed, precision, and quick decision-making are key! As a top-down isometric shopper , your goal is simple but relentless: grab the correct items for incoming orders, sort them into your baskets, and deliver them to the checkout—before time runs out! Sounds easy? Think again! Moving obstacles, rogue trolleys, and shifting store layouts will keep you on your toes. The challenge never stops, and every second counts in your pursuit of the highest score ! How long can you keep up the dash before the supermarket chaos overwhelms you? Key Features: 🛒 Endless, Fast-Paced Gameplay – Orders keep coming, and it’s up to you to keep up! There’s no finish line—only the high score. 🏃 Dodge & Weave Through Obstacles – Avoid rogue trolleys, navigate moving and rotating shelves , and plan your route efficiently! 🎯 Two-Basket System – Manage your baskets strategically to grab and deliver orders efficiently. ⏳ Race Against the Clock – The faster you fulfill orders, the more points you earn. But if you take too long, it’s game over! 📈 Global & Local Leaderboards – Compete against friends and players worldwide to claim the title of the ultimate trolley dasher ! 🎨 Vibrant Isometric Art Style – A colorful, stylized supermarket full of life, movement, and just the right amount of chaos. Design: Trolley Dash captures the thrill of classic arcade score-chasing , blending tight controls, fast decision-making, and lighthearted chaos into an addictive gameplay loop. Easy to learn, but tough to master , every run is a new chance to climb the leaderboards. Do you have the reflexes and strategy to become the #1 shopper ? Grab your trolley and prove it!
row.short_description: Trolley Dash is a fast-paced, endless arcade game where you race to grab items, fill orders, and deliver them before time runs out! You must dodge rogue trolleys, navigate shifting shelves, and react fast to keep up with the chaos. Can you get to the top of the leaderboards? Good luck!

row.name: 我的时光：大学日记 Playtest
Slime Trials
row.detailed_description: Slime Trials is a difficult platformer built around speed and momentum.  Creatively use your jump and dash together to reach incredible speeds while avoiding deadly obstacles. Race the clock to set new records for each hand-crafted level.  Explore multiple paths and find collectables to unlock more skins for your character.
row.short_description: A fast-paced, precision platformer where you dash, jump, and build momentum to soar through dangerous levels. Crush the speedrun clock or take your time to collect all the valuable gems and unlock hats for your slime.

row.name: Virion
row.detailed_description: Created by students at the University of Silicon Valley as a school project, Virion is an isometric action roguelike with a strong emphasis on player expression through movement. It follows a virus called Nebula attempting to escape from the watchful gaze of the Mother Computer, who seeks to eradicate it. Current Features: Combat against three enemy types Ranged and melee combat Procedural generation of levels featuring a variety of handcrafted rooms Powerups that affect gameplay NPCs that give backstory into the world of Virion
row.short_description: A sci-fi action roguelike with frenetic combat including ranged, melee and dodging

row.name: Lottery World
row.detailed_description: Stay calm, make wise decisions, improve your gaming skills, gain experience, make new friends, and strive to become the wealthiest player! ◆ Game Features ◆ Free Coins: Log in daily to receive free coins and easily start the game! Online Chat: Interact in real-time with global players, make new friends, and enjoy lively conversations. Golden Card Kingdom: A poker suit guessing game where players compete on the same platform. Guess the golden card and win a bonus multiplier! Who will be the big winner? Rock Paper Scissors: A classic game everyone knows. Come and enjoy “Rock Paper Scissors” with your friends!
row.short_description: A free-to-play global multiplayer online arcade gaming platform.

row.name: Oublivious
row.detailed_description: Oublivious is a fast-paced time-chaser combat platformer set in a medieval dungeon where you play as a desperate thief seeking treasure to achieve the fame and fortune you've always desired, however, you must avoid traps and defeat enemies guarding this treasure. The game blends first-person action platforming with subtle RPG elements, offering a thrilling, momentum-based experience.
row.short_description: Oublivious is a fast-paced combat platformer where you play as a daring thief battling through a deadly dungeon. Master precise platforming, overcome medieval traps, and defeat challenging enemies to uncover hidden treasure and achieve fame and fortune.

row.name: Are You Happy
row.detailed_description: You have died, and have gone to hell. Visit different creatures and answer their questions about yourself. Proceed to the death himself The game is a walking simulator about answering questions about your own life. Were you loved? What was the meaning of your life? The game is very bleak with visuals and audio that shows the main character's inner world. Are you ready to come home? Features: Dark art style using voxel graphics Disturbing and creepy soundtrack Short length
row.short_description: Short psychological horror experience

row.name: NOODS
row.detailed_description: NOODS (Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans) are lil digital buddies that hang out on your desktop, helping you focus on your work and resist the siren call of procrastination. They come with a bunch of tools for maintaining a positive and healthy work environment everywhere from your home PC to your work laptop, while always saving room to have some fun. Niche Operators The first official release features raccoon gamer girl Lily, hand-animated in a charming pixel style and hell bent on keeping you company as you go about your daily computer tasks. As multiple characters are released, you will be able to switch between Operators with the look, personality, and habits best suited for the task at hand. In later releases, we aim to make a tool to allow you to create your own Operator from scratch. Cool, right? Stay Focused Part idle clicker, part virtual buddy, this niche operator has many useful abilities; timers, schedules, window features, (and more to come!) so keep an eye out for upcoming releases. Designed to keep you focused and facilitate your real-life tasks, your Operator is just the right balance of subtle and functional to provide what you need; no more opening multiple pomodoro timers and schedule apps to stay on track; it’s all here. Simple n’ sweet. A Little Spice You won’t get away with slacking on your Operator’s watch: if left to her own devices, Lily has been known to get in a bit of trouble now and again. Keep your important windows out of her reach, and let her help you stay productive! Or else. Features To-Do Lists (Checklists) Pomodoro Timer Screenshots Stopwatch Alarms Window destruction Baseline Lily shenanigans (including window theft) Hidden minigame(s) Original sounds & music Audio & Graphics settings and customization Integrated feedback & bug reporting
row.short_description: Get ready to spice up your screen with NOODS—Niche Operators Orchestrating Desktop Shenanigans! These cheeky, animated desktop buddies bring chaotic fun, quirky reminders, and interactive antics straight to your workspace.

row.name: Project Hailstorm
row.detailed_description: Project Hailstorm is a short, 15 minute long narrative driven story set deep within the Antarctic circle. Step into the shoes of a recovery team as they attempt to uncover what happened over half a decade ago. UNCOVER THE MYSTERY Travel deep below the surface of the Antarctic and uncover just exactly what the dig team discovered that day. HIGH QUALITY SHORT-FORM GAMING A videogame short story, experience high quality visuals as you're moved through a dramatic and atmospheric environment set in the depths of the Antarctic. DISCOVER THE BEHIND THE SCENES Take a look at the behind the scenes documentary and look at what it takes to bring something like this to life!
row.short_description: Step into the shoes of a researcher in the depths of the antarctic and uncover the mysteries behind Project Hailstorm.

《蜀山：初章》正式版

2）个人洞府、三千世界、自由刷装 无限探索：玩家可以在诸多大世界中自由探索，无需 遵循严格的剧情线路或特定的路线。 3）PVE玩法、野外世界首领争夺 世界首领争夺是基于队伍的PVE玩法 BOSS掉落：装备、铜币，高阶BOSS掉落稀有法宝、材料 4）PVE玩法、野外首领地宫争夺 地宫入口、BOSS可以PK争夺 5）PVE玩法、大团本九华山 row.name: HoloSona5
row.detailed_description: Overview A mini-RPG that is a fan-made work of Hololive and is strongly influenced by a certain modern phantom thief RPG. The SNS service, Poitter, is in danger as a billionaire plans to buy it. Three Hololive live streamers, Subaru Ozora, Koyori Hiroi, and Miko Sakura, step up to help. In order to reform the billionaire, they use Horox's mysterious technology to challenge the labyrinth and the wall of the billionaire's heart. Description A small game that lasts about 1 to 2 hours with conversations, dungeons, and battles. There is one stage and several layers of the map. Battles are turn-based, with each character choosing their actions. If you hit a weak point, the opponent will be knocked down, and your attack will always hit. If you knock them down, you can take another action. Also, if all enemies are knocked down, you can launch a full attack. In the dungeon, you move square by square, and use jumps, dashes, etc. to move efficiently. Each character has a limit, but they recover when the floor changes. You can purchase items and equipment from the shop from the menu screen. Each character can equip up to three pieces of equipment, regardless of the equipment part. The same item cannot be equipped. The recovery amount of recovery items may differ depending on the character. This is because each character has likes and dislikes. Notes In order to liven up the game, voice actors have been used to voice each character. If you can't get used to the voices, please turn down the voice volume in the configuration screen. Motivation for making it Ozora Subaru was playing Modern Phantom Thief RPG 5, and he was so impressed that he bought it himself and thought it was fun, so he made this with that momentum. The three people I chose are live streamers who had a connection with those games when development began. Why don't you apply for 'holo Indie'? I applied, but I was rejected. Maybe I was too aggressive. I don't know the details, but I hope you enjoy it.
row.short_description: A Hololive fanmade RPG inspired by modern phantom thief games. You save the 'Poitter' from being taken over by a millionaire. A 1-2 hour turn-based game where you explore dungeons and exploit weaknesses in combat.

row.name: Klondike's Hike: A Solitaire Roguelike
row.detailed_description: Not happy with the cards you have been dealt? What if you could change that? In Klondike's Hike, you battle enemies by completing solitaire puzzles, and you can beat the random odds by modifying your cards and changing the rules of the game to progress further and further against the many hazards thrown at you. Modify your deck until it is unrecognizable and try to defeat all the bosses to reach the Shores of Gold! Modify the board You can use items to grab cards from behind piles, reorder whole columns, or even re-deal the entire tableau. Modify the rules Who's to say you can only build down? Use the trading cards to change the very base rules of the game! Your opponents are cheating anyway, so why shouldn't you?
row.short_description: Klondike, a gold-panning otter, had a vision of golden shores up in the mountains. Help her reach this mythical place in this solitaire-based roguelike! Use items to modify your cards, bend the rules, and power through the many traps in your way.

row.name: Shelter from the Storm

You spot an old, dilapidated house looming in the distance - a beacon of shelter in the downpour. You knock loudly desperate to escape the rain. No answer. You try the handle, the door creeks opens... Point & Click You play a curious wanderer who's stumbled into more than they've bargained for. Explore the forgotten corners of the once-grand house, now seemingly abandoned and shrouded in mystery. Find and make us of objects you find lying around, crack codes, solve puzzles and progress through the various rooms of the house while waiting out the storm. Features A classic 2D point & click adventure game with: Simplified interactions - You don't have to randomly try combining every object. If you click on something and have an item you can use with it, you do. Retro graphics - Kicking it old school with a low resolution pixel art style and a 4:3 aspect ratio. Widescreen will never catch on. Manageable length - Tied of never having enough time to finish games? You can probably wrap this one up in about 30 mins. Occasional humour - There's a joke or two throw in for good measure.
row.short_description: Rain lashes down soaking you to the bone, you take shelter in a seemingly abandoned house. Navigate through the rooms solving puzzles and trying to escape in this short point & click adventure game.

row.name: Valiant Worlds: Adventure of Falken
row.detailed_description: Step into a vibrant world of balance and discord, where the powers of the Sun and Moon once coexisted in harmony but now teeter on the edge of collapse. Valiant Worlds: Adventure of Falken immerses players in a detailed universe filled with characters, and exhilarating combat, all tied together by a compelling story of unity and strife. Key Features: Dynamic Day-Night Cycle: Experience a living world where time influences gameplay. The Sun enhances power and vitality, while the Moon empowers dexterity and intelligence. Your choices shape the balance of this cosmic dance. Exploration and Adventure: Traverse ten unique biomes, from the frozen wilderness to the fiery depths of Emberflow Crater and the sandstorm-swept Crimson Sands. Each location brims with NPCs, treasures, and challenging foes. Rich Narrative: Uncover the secrets of the Sun and Moon through interactive storytelling, unraveling a tale of their fractured harmony. NPCs guide your journey with lore. Combat and Strategy: Engage in hack-and-slash combat, mastering weapons and abilities. Defeat enemies, gather resources, and craft gear to overcome increasingly powerful adversaries. Progression and Customization: Build your character with diverse stats like attack damage, resistance, and unique Sun and Moon powers. Equip items like swords, helmets, armor, and accessories to enhance your abilities and suit your playstyle. Farm-Like Gameplay Elements: Battle enemies to collect valuable items and resources. Use these to craft, trade, and grow stronger, creating a rewarding loop of exploration and progression. Gameplay Summary: In Valiant Worlds: Adventure of Falken , players will: Mine and Chop Resources: Interact with the world to gather essential materials. Hold down keys to mine ores or chop trees for character development. Engage with NPCs:   Trade items with merchants, and gain insight into the world through conversations. Equip: Unlock gear to upgrade your character's stats. Battle Enemies: Use your strategy, and environment to conquer a variety of foes. Why It Stands Out: With its combination of story, exploration, engaging combat, and strategic elements, Valiant Worlds: Adventure of Falken offers an immersive experience that appeals to both casual players and RPG enthusiasts. It blends the best of isometric RPG design with innovative gameplay mechanics, creating a world that is both challenging and captivating. Prepare to forge your path and restore balance to the world of Valient Worlds: Adventure of Falken ! More Info About the Game There are 10 unique maps and there are 20 unique enemy characters. Enemy mobs distributed over these maps by considering maps' tiers. Tier 1 Maps: Harmony Village -> Level 1 and 5 mobs spawn. Harmony Town -> Level 10 and 15 mobs spawn. Tier 2 Maps: Lunar Veil Marsh -> Level 20, 25 and 30 mobs spawn. Eclipse Forest -> Level 35, 40 and 45 mobs spawn. Radiant Glade -> Level 50, 55 and 60 mobs spawn. Tier 3 Maps: Shimmering Mountains -> Level 65, 70 and 75 mobs spawn. Emberflow Crater -> Level 80, 85 and 90 mobs spawn. Tier 4 Maps: Frostspire Hallow -> Level 95 mobs spawn. Mycoria Glade -> Level 95 mobs spawn. Crimson Sands -> Level 95 mobs spawn. More Info About the Gameplay By considering the level, player farms on an appropriate map and collect items. There are two merchants. The first one is on the Harmony Village map and the second one is on the Harmony Town map. Player can sell items to them to more profit. Also, he can buy things like health and mana potions. When player is powerful enough to farm on upper tier maps, he goes to farm there. He can upgrade his items from the blacksmith on Harmony Town. Merchant Info Village Elder: After talking with him, merchant panel appears. Town Merchant: After talking with him, merchant panel appears. On opened merchant panel, if player clicks to 'Sell' button, the button turns out to green color which means selling toggled on and player can sell its items. If clicks again to that button, the button turns out the red, and that means toggled off, so player cannot sell items for that time. Blacksmith Info Town Blacksmith: When near him, upgrading panel appears. On opened panel, player click to 'Upgrade' button once and the button turns to green, after that player selects the item from his inventory to upgrade. If the player has enough power shards (currency), the blacksmith upgrades the item. If clicked to 'Upgrade' button again, the button turns to red which means upgrading function disabled for that time and vice versa. Mining Stones and Chopping Trees Mine Stone: When near it, panel occurs for mining. Player needs to press the key for required time to mine it. After successful attempt, player gets some rewards like (+1 Strength etc.). There are so many stones all over the maps. Find them and get the rewards. Chopping Tree: When near it, panel occurs for chopping. Player needs to press the key for required time to chop it. After successful attempt, player gets some rewards. There are so many special trees all over the maps. Find them and get the rewards.
row.short_description: With its combination of story, exploration, engaging combat, and strategic elements, Valiant Worlds: Adventure of Falken offers an immersive experience. It blends the best of isometric RPG design with innovative gameplay mechanics, creating a world that is both challenging and captivating.

row.name: Double Shoulders
