Faced with obstacles, their best hope lies in mutual support. Will they make it through a journey that will bring them closer together, reveal secrets as mysterious as they are terrifying, and, above all, save them from a grim fate?” ESCAPE WITH YOUR NEWFOUND COMPANION Play as Lois and Sam, two unlikely friends who must work together to escape this twisted place. HUMANOIDS DEFORMED TO ADAPT TO THEIR GRIM LABOR Be careful, you’re not alone. Strange monstrosities lurk in this place. They were once human like you, but this place changed them. Now, they’re merely shadows of what they once were, and they won’t hesitate to put you back in line. Don’t get caught, or you might end up like them. WITHIN A DARK AND DEADLY ENVIRONMENT HIDING A HEAVY SECRET Traverse the facility and explore a variety of environments. Each one presents its own unique challenges and dangers. WILL YOU ESCAPE THIS PLACE, OR END UP LIKE THE OTHERS ? NB:   Double Shoulders   is a graduation game made in one year by a team of 9 students. Thank you for your consideration regarding potential bugs and performance issues.
row.short_description: Double Shoulders is a two player action-adventure game. You take control of Lois and Sam, two kids trying to escape from a strange place filled with dangers and challenges. You'll have to work together to get out of this place alive.
row.notes: Double Shoulders contains violent elements that primarily focus on the main characters, who are children. While their deaths can be brutal and violent, the game does not feature grotesque gore or dismemberment. The violent scenes are suggestive and serve the story, without aiming to shock or provoke excessively. It is important to note that players may encounter moments of tension and emotional distress that contribute to the dark and oppressive atmosphere of the game. However, no explicitly shocking content such as sexual assaults, alcohol or drug abuse, or self-harm is present. We advise players sensitive to such content to consider this approach before embarking on the adventure.

row.name: DUET
row.detailed_description: DUET is an interactive story illustrating the Hifuu Club's first encounter. It   is a wordless, narrative-driven experience about connection, small moments, and the quiet magic of two lives intertwining. Renko Usami lives a simple life, endlessly cycling through studying, eating, and sleeping at university. She gazes at the starry sky alone, trying to fill the emptiness in her heart. Then, one day, Maribel Hearn appears—a girl who seems to have stepped from beyond the boundaries of the world... Features & Content: Wordless, Interactive Storytelling : Experience Renko & Merry's subtle yet fateful daily moments through a series of light, meaningful interactions. Handcrafted Atmosphere:  Immerse yourself in lovingly crafted hand-drawn visuals and a gentle soundtrack that enriches the story’s warmth. A Delicate Story to Explore : Step into and witness Renko and Merry's encounter that intertwines their lives. Catch the quiet warmth hidden like a butterfly in the stillness of their shared world. Short, Sweet Experience:  DUET is crafted to be completed in a single sitting. It invites you to slow down and enjoy a calm, quiet, and heartfelt experience. DUET is a Touhou Project fan game, inspired by the indie masterpiece Florence . It paints a story that is sweet, delicate, and profoundly touching.
row.short_description: DUET illustrates the Hifuu Club's first encounter. It is a wordless, narrative-driven experience about connection and small moments in life. Step into the subtle yet fateful daily interactions that intertwine Renko and Merry's lives.

row.name: Shieven
row.detailed_description: Shieven is a suspenseful exploration game that puts you in the shoes of an investigator whose financial situation is on the verge of collapse. In a desperate attempt to solve his problems, he takes on a case at the mysterious Luminora Hospital, a place shrouded in dark and chilling rumors. According to the stories, those who ventured beyond the hospital's surface levels have never been seen again. Dive into the depths of Luminora Hospital and uncover what happened there in the past... Discover chilling secrets that were never meant to see the light... Escape from terrifying creatures or monsters lurking below... Pay attention to everything ... The Security Flashlight is a versatile tool designed to help you face any danger and explore new paths. You'll find it during your journey through the depths of the hospital. With its powerful light and sound, it becomes an indispensable ally to keep you safe and push forward in the darkest moments. Use it wisely... We are an indie studio at the beginning of our creative journey, focused on learning and improving continuously. Our plan includes releasing more chapters of Shieven and exploring new ideas, whether by staying within the same style or venturing into completely different genres. Additionally, we are open to collaborations to keep growing and deliver unique experiences to our community.
row.short_description: Venture into the enigmatic Luminora Hospital, where, as an investigator on the brink of ruin, you take on a case that will test your courage. Amidst dark rumors, you'll uncover terrifying secrets that have caused those who ventured too far to disappear.
row.notes: This game contains mild depictions of blood and gore in certain scenes. These elements are not overly graphic but may still be unsuitable for younger audiences.

row.name: HAILSTORM
row.detailed_description: Break bricks with the ball and paddle to build your meter. When its full you can pull the lever for the slot machine and see how lucky you are (or not).
row.short_description: HAILSTORM is a new take on the classic break breaking arcade game. Break bricks to earn points and build the gambling meter for your next lever pull. Then pull that lever and watch chaos slowly unfold.

row.name: Defenders of the Dune
row.detailed_description: BUILD. DEFEND. CONQUER. Step onto a sunlit beach where imagination meets strategy in Defenders of the Dune ! In this real-time strategy game, players take control of a sandcastle kingdom, constructing buildings, training units, and preparing defenses against waves of enemies. The game revolves around a dynamic day-night cycle that keeps you on your toes. Use the day to gather resources, build fortifications, and expand your territory. But beware, As night falls, brace yourself for attacks from swarming ant armies and other adversaries threatening your sandcastle empire. Features include: Base Building : Construct and upgrade structures to create a thriving sandcastle civilization. Unit Management : Train specialized units to defend your kingdom and launch attacks on enemy burrows. Customizable Strategies : Unlock and experiment with unique buildings, equipment, and units to perfect your strategy. Dynamic Threats : Face off against challenging enemies and contend with building decay outside your base’s range. Final Wave Challenge : Face the ultimate test of your sandcastle empire in a climactic showdown with an overwhelming ant army. Whether you’re a seasoned RTS fan or a newcomer to the genre, Defenders of the Dune offers a charming yet deeply tactical experience. Can you withstand the tide and claim victory, or will your efforts wash away with the waves?
row.short_description: Defenders of the Dune is a game about overcoming the wilderness and establishing a kingdom in defiance of the land itself. Players will fight to survive each day, experiencing the challenge and pride that comes with building up their base against all odds

row.name: Yap Wizards Tower Defence
row.detailed_description: Mad machinations are underfoot on the Dirt Path. Take up arms and defend the Dirt Path with divine arms. Broaden your horizons and dynamically  scale up the battle after each wave! Learn about the the yapping wizards aiding in your Tower Defence! Survive the overwhelming hordes and be granted  epic   ranks from the Grand Tutorial Wizard! Upend the corruption of the system and enact social change, one Gnoblin at a time... Or ruin the fields by enacting zoning for the Ballistas. Again.
row.short_description: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!

row.detailed_description: Welcome to 25920! The distance from the lowest submarine to the highest airplane (In America units of course) Your goal is to destroy the enemy craft before they do the same to you. Whoever loses all Submarines OR Boats OR Planes first loses the game. Why? Because war is all about terrain superiority, and how could you fight with no craft? Now this isn't like those other grid based water craft guessing games. There are abilities, boons, and several other twists thrown in to make it a unique game each time. Play against the computer or locally with a friend. Can you beat Alexander the great if Alexander had battleships? Can you beat your snot nosed cousin after family dinner? (Probably that kid is an idiot) There are submarines AND boats AND planes in ONE game. What more is there to say?
row.short_description: Three dimensional grid turn-based strategy game. Combat the computer or your friends to prove your brain is less smooth than theirs.

row.name: Eva's Hook
row.detailed_description: 'Eva's Hook' is a 2.5D platformer that tests your precision and reflexes through a series of challenging levels. Follow Eva on her journey to break free from the icy prison that holds her, armed only with her trusty grappling hook. Created entirely by a solo indie developer, this game is a tribute to pure gameplay – no frills, no intrusive storytelling. It's just you, your mouse, and your ability to master precise movement. Key Features: 🪝 Intuitive Grappling Hook Mechanic – Move swiftly and accurately with a mouse-controlled grappling system. 🎯 Tight Platforming – Perfect for players who love technical challenges. Every jump and swing counts. 💎 Collect and Explore – Gather coins scattered throughout the levels. ⚡ Multiple Game Modes: Campaign – Traverse 6 core levels and unlock 3 bonus levels with evolving challenges. Speedrun Mode – Race against the clock by selecting levels and aiming for the fastest times. 🌟 Dynamic Events – Experience unexpected shifts that will test and reshape your approach. 🎮 Three Difficulty Levels – Whether you're here for a casual run or a hardcore challenge, there's a mode for you. 'Eva's Hook' won't tell you an elaborate story, but it will offer hours of engaging gameplay. By the end of this adventure, when Eva finally shatters her icy prison, it will be thanks to your skill.
row.short_description: A 2.5D Platformer with a Grappling Hook, Collectibles, and a Timer for an extra Challenge while different Events are trying to make you fail, 3 different Difficulties, but even the Easiest one could be a hard time for you !

row.name: Kewter’s Showroom
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Kewter's Showroom! The only dress up game that really teaches you how to dress! Kewter, the owner of the showroom and long time experienced fashionista, is here to help you! Listen to her suggestions and you're sure to succeed! She does have tons of experience, you know...  You have 7 days to become the greatest fashion diva in the world (well, second best...)! There are themes for every day's fashion show and you will be graded based off how well you matched the theme. Do your best! If you're unsure, you can always use Kewter's recommended items!  Disclaimer! This game contains disturbing content and loud noises.  Game contents: 7 playable days  Fashion shows! Over 70 outfit parts to assemble the perfect combination. Fully voiced cutscenes. 1 ending (+ bonus video if you get perfect scores on all 7 days) Nostalgic 2000s video game sounds and aesthetics. The Steam version includes new exclusive special events!
row.short_description: A 2000s styled dress up game with a dark twist.
row.notes: Contains gory imagery (not super realistic, but drawings of a body without a head is displayed) Contains loud sounds and disturbing images

row.name: イマジナリーバッドフレンド
row.detailed_description: Regarding Live Commentary and Streaming Live streaming and broadcasting are permitted throughout the entire game. Monetization is also allowed. You may freely use screenshots for thumbnails and other purposes up until the point where the ending branches diverge. (After the branching point, thumbnail use is prohibited to avoid spoilers.) Please include a link to the store page in your video description. Do not include the contents of the DLC artbook in your videos. summary One day, a boy named “Shiomi” suddenly appears and the main character recognizes him as an imaginary friend that only he can see. Shiomi is kind to him, preparing games and feeding him cake, but he is also somewhat suspicious, for example, he stops him from going out of the room. ...... This is a short visual novel game of about 30 minutes in which you play and talk with Shiomi and find out what happened to the main character. game system The game progresses by reading a conversation with Shiomi and choosing one of two options that occasionally appear during the conversation. There are two endings. Please see how the two of you end up together. ※Contains depictions of bloodshed. credits BGM:イワシロ音楽素材 SE：無料効果音で遊ぼう！ Font：せのびゴシック　MODI工場（モーディーコウジョウ）
row.short_description: A short visual novel game in which a boy named Shiomi suddenly appears one day, and the protagonist, who recognizes him as an imaginary friend, converses with him to find out what happened between them.
row.notes: This game contains partial depictions of blood, mild violence, and indirect portrayal of suicide.

row.name: スライムブリュー Playtest
Signal
row.detailed_description: A dark and mysterious planet There are two unique zones to explore in which many secrets are yet to be uncovered. By overcoming the challenges in your path, you will be rewarded with information about your mentor as well as a new power, but it will not be easy. A hostile welcome A lot of dangerous creatures are roaming around, so be ready to fight and don't let them make the first move. The combat is fast paced and can be brutal if you underestimate your enemies. Perform strong martial arts combos and dodge incoming attacks to defeat your foes. Survival of the fittest Collect as many resources as you can if you want to succeed in your mission. Using the crafting menu you can combine plants to make injections that can heal your wounds or make your attacks more powerful. You can also find all the log entries that you've discovered and some information about the creatures you've defeated by navigating trough your inventory.
row.short_description: Signal is an immersive action-adventure game made as a student project where you attempt to uncover the mystery behind your old mentor's distress message. To succeed in your mission, you will have to use your martial arts skills and fight off hostile creatures that are trying to stop you.
row.notes: Blood, weapons, mild cursing, implied cannibalism,

row.name: Beetle Barrage
row.detailed_description: About This Game Play as a robotic beetle and destroy all of the insects in your way! Destroy ants with a wide range of abilities and barrage your way to the largest score. As a mechanized beetle, you shoot with your weapon to move from the recoil it has. Scavenge for better abilities to become the one true insect. Features 5 abilities that you can pick up. 2 enemies. Get the largest score as possible. Soundtrack The OST for Beetle Barrage can be found on most streaming platforms, YouTube, Bandcamp, and SoundCloud under the artist: I Have No Mouth
row.short_description: Destroy all of the insects in your way! As you shoot, you recoil backward from your weapons as a mechanical beetle.

row.name: BikeRide IMMERSIV AUDIO
row.detailed_description: Innovative stereophonic sound technology, now in everyone's hands Advanced stereophonic sound technology, which was once considered difficult, can now be easily experienced by anyone. The “Motorcycle Sound Simulator” is a completely new approach to simulation that makes it easy for anyone to understand and utilize complex sound technology. The “Motorcycle Sound Simulator” uses Yamaha Corporation's Sound xR™ stereophonic technology. “This application uses Sound xR™ spatial audio processing engine for earphones and headphones, i.e. Binauralizer from Yamaha Corporation.” Democratizing Technology - Anyone, Anywhere, Easily Complex technology into a simple experience No specialized knowledge required No special equipment required Experience professional-grade stereophonic sound with just one pair of headphones Innovative tool for learning and practicing at the same time Not just for game developers, but for anyone interested in sound Practical sound experience, not theory Intuitive sound movement and spatial expression Everyone can be a sound creator This simulator is the very “gateway” tool to democratize advanced acoustic technology. Without complicated technical knowledge or expensive equipment, you can experience the fascination of stereophonic sound and apply it to your own projects. Include the explanatory text “This is using Sound xR,” (explaining that it is stereophonic sound). New possibilities of sound for everyone Stereophonic sound is no longer just for a few experts. The Bike Ride Simulator Sound xR is an innovative tool that democratizes sound technology and makes it easily accessible to everyone. Unleash your creativity with sound! Translated with (free version)
row.short_description: これまで難しいとされてきた高度な立体音響技術が、今、誰もが簡単に体験できる時代に。『バイクサウンド シミュレーター』は、複雑な音響技術を誰もが手軽に理解し、活用できるようにした、まったく新しいアプローチのシミュレーターです。

row.name: Sound scape
row.detailed_description: Acoustic simulation for professionals to experience the essence of sound Soundscape is an interactive platform for game developers and sound designers to deeply understand stereophonic technology. 'Soundscape' uses Yamaha Corporation's stereophonic sound technology Sound xR™. “This application uses Sound xR spatial audio processing engine for earphones and headphones, i.e. Binauralizer from Yamaha Corporation.” 5 acoustic exploration modes Precise acoustic experience Bird call localization Accurate localization of sound sources in natural environments Subtle sound travel and distance analysis Urban Acoustic Challenges Extracting specific sounds in complex sound environments Understanding realistic acoustic spaces Sound Source Tracking Identifying the exact source of an explosion Practical understanding of sound propagation mechanisms Acoustic space navigation Understanding space based on sound alone Deep insight into sound localization and spatial awareness Analysis of moving sound Experience the sound changes of a racing kart and a train Detailed observation of dynamic acoustic environments Technical Stereophonic Experience Experience realistic sound using Sound xR's stereophonic technology. This is a technical and experimental game that goes deeper than regular stereophonic acoustics. Acoustic technology for professionals Simulation of a variety of sound sources and acoustic environments Advanced acoustic experience with standard headphones Acoustics directly applicable to game development Acoustic tools for indie game developers and engineers This simulation is not just a game, but a practical learning platform for acoustic technology. Practical understanding of stereophonic sound technology Insights into acoustic design in game development Stimulates technical creativity System Requirements OS: Windows 10 64bit Processor: Intel Core i5 or higher Memory: 4 GB RAM Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 (2 GB) or higher Storage: 5 GB available free space Sound: Stereo headphones required Controls Keyboard or controller to explore sound sources Deep understanding of the technical aspects of stereophonic sound Explore new horizons of acoustic technology from a professional perspective. Translated with (free version)
row.short_description: 「サウンドスケープ」は音の本質を体験する、プロフェッショナルのための音響シミュレーションです。 ゲーム開発者とサウンドデザイナーのための、立体音響技術を深く理解するインタラクティブ・プラットフォームです。

row.name: Hunter Hitman
row.detailed_description: Hunter Hitman is a fast-paced, action-packed stealth game that puts you in the shoes of a deadly assassin. Tap to move silently through a high-security desert military base. Sneak behind enemies and execute clean assassinations to rack up kills. Outsmart and outmaneuver enemies while unlocking new skills and rewards to boost your game. How long can you survive the hunt? Features Thrilling stealth gameplay with tactical movement. Collect cash to unlock unique skins and customize your look. Earn daily rewards and achievements to keep progressing. Open gacha loot boxes to collect cards. Assemble and upgrade cards level Hunt or be hunted. Stay sharp, move smart, and keep hunting.
row.short_description: Hunt or be hunted. Execute stealth kills and survive in this action-packed assassin game.

row.name: Hidden Tomatoes 2
row.detailed_description: Find 100 hidden tomatoes scattered across a vibrant 3D city. Explore detailed urban areas with colorful graphics that bring the streets, buildings, and alleys to life. With relaxing music and a calm atmosphere, enjoy uncovering each tomato at your own pace in this visually stunning environment. Gameplay: 🍅 1 Level, 100 hidden tomatoes in a city setting. 👉 Click on the tomatoes you find. 💡 Hint System Features: - Explore a lively city with beautifully designed urban landscape. - No time limits—take your time and enjoy the hunt. - Fun and challenging for players of all ages. Can you find all the hidden tomatoes in the city? Start your adventure now!
row.short_description: Search for 100 hidden tomatoes in a detailed city. Explore the streets, buildings, and alleys with no time limits. Can you find them all? 🍅

row.name: CroquettesClicker
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in a world where every click counts! Your goal? Accumulate kibble to unlock new improvements and conquer the world of felines. But be careful, management is key: invest strategically to maximize your kibbles per second (CPS) and participate in dynamic mini-games to boost your production. Main features: 🐾 Varied mini-games: Test your reflexes and strategy with fun challenges. 🐾 Endless Upgrades: Unlock factories, interstellar convoys, and even kibble black holes. 🐾 Immersive atmosphere: A “Cat Night” mode with stars and animations to change the atmosphere. Whether you are a cat lover, a fan of incremental games or simply curious, CroquettesClicker is for you. Be careful, it can cause a crunchy feline addiction!
row.short_description: An incremental game based on kibble and cats! Collect, upgrade and manage your kibble to reach undreamt-of heights. Can you become the ultimate kibble master?

row.name: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul Prologue
row.detailed_description: (This is a single player prologue game for Alchemist: Journey of the Soul ) A voice calls to you—a familiar presence, the Alchemist . He speaks of a place that calls to him, an ancient monastery at the mountain’s peak, where your true purpose will unfold.  Explore the monastery, solve puzzles and brew powerful potions. With each new potion a new ability is unlocked. You’ll need to observe closely and think carefully. Α portal opens. A door beyond. And your journey is only just beginning... WISHLIST NOW and follow the journey to its end!
row.short_description: First-person escape room game. Use your magical abilities to solve puzzles or navigate through areas! Explore, use items, brew potions and unlock your full alchemical potential. Are you willing to do what it takes to claim a soul of your own?

row.name: Obscura
row.detailed_description: [THIS IS A DEMO] OBSCURA Dive into the mysterious atmosphere of Obscura, a first-person investigative game where you play as a medium determined to solve unsolved cases. Explore places haunted by tragic events and uncover the secrets buried in the shadows. Explore the invisible, reveal the truth. As a medium, your unique gift allows you to communicate with spirits and discover fragments of the past. Search an abandoned apartment, observe the smallest details, and collect objects linked to past tragedies. Each clue brings you closer to the truth, but be warned, some truths are darker than they appear. Rituals to reveal the unspeakable. Collect items marked by the past and use mysterious rituals to uncover buried memories. Combine the right ritual fragments to trigger visions and reconstruct crime scenes. Each revelation will guide you toward solving the case. Will you be ready to face the buried truths of Obscura?
row.short_description: Obscura is a first-person investigation game where, you play a medium who must solve cold cases by interacting with various elements and performing rituals. Learn about their past to understand their motives and crack the case. Please understand that the game will features sensitive topics.
row.notes: The game discusses sensitive topics such as abortion, and may not be suitable for all audiences.

row.name: Tower Of Penguinaria
row.detailed_description: General: Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica.  What Makes This Game Different: In addition to being a Rougelite, RPG, Dungeon Crawler, Timeloop, game (where character stats improve based on what you wear). Depending on what you wear will change what you're move set in the turn based combat will do! There is also a death loop feature. Dying will make you enter Kenos (land of the dead) where you can unlock metaprogression to give yourself more time, or power, to defeat the Sealsorer who lurks on top of the Tower. Finally a mix of unique enemies, traps, and bosses makes even crawling on this randomly generated 2d dungeon engaging. Timing runs over dangerous spikes, dodging meteors, and blocking attacks on the game map, before heading into the battlefield keeps crawling dynamic and fun! Game Loop: Enter the dungeon to get xp and money Buy new gear to get further (and unlock checkpoints) perish or run out of time, allowing you to spend those hard earned levels on permanent buffs Credits: Developer: RpgPenguin Artists: RpgPenguin, BlueIsTopia
row.short_description: Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica. Through turn based combats where your gear effects what abilities you will learn to aid in battle!

row.name: Smiling Misery
row.detailed_description: Inspired by the medieval Mediterranean. This is the story of a time long past. A time when people lived in peace and well-being in the region of Verigo after an event that would be known as... The Garlic Wars. In an enormous castle lived Margo, a young jester who served her lord at court. Margo enjoyed a life of absolute comfort and privilege; possessions, favors, compliments, and even a close relationship with her king. A dream life that took a turn due to a twisted desire that would blossom in the heart of young Margo... Unhappiness, sadness, all the ills of mankind suddenly turned into guilty desires for the young jester. Thus, one day Margo left the castle with a very clear purpose. 'I want to know misery.' Offering a lifetime of service to anyone who could help her see her desires come true. What the young woman did not know was that the real world would be one very different from what she expected. Main Keys: Space to talk. Left & Right Arrows on the screen to move across the map. Esc for skip the intro. Space to pass text. Esc -> Skip, sometimes.
row.short_description: Smiling Misery is an interactive tale that introduces us to the story of Margo, a jester who, weary of a comfortable life, embarks on a journey to seek misery. Join Margo on a brief adventure through a Mediterranean medieval kingdom and bring the story to its conclusion.

row.name: Billie Beetleneck -A detective tale-
row.detailed_description: Billie Beetleneck: A detective tale is a visual novel about a beetle trying to solve his hardest case yet. An unusual number of booklice and humans have escaped their worlds to seek refuge in Bugtown due to a large number of attacks from bookworms. Bookworms feed on knowledge by eating up pages of various books and destroying the worlds within in the process. Characters inside the books must flee, or perish during such devastating attacks.  A detective story with some player choices Colorful visuals and characters in anime style A playtime of: 2-4 hours
row.short_description: Every story ever written has an alternate world that coexists with ours. When a large number of parallel universes are suddenly destroyed, Billie Beetleneck sets off on his hardest case yet in this interactive visual novel.

row.name: Ensemble Simulator
row.detailed_description: Ensemble Simulator” is a simulation game that allows you to create a musical space that resembles real orchestra conducting using your own music data. The ultra-stereoscopic sound technology of Sound xR™ allows you to easily create a stereoscopic sound even with your own Threteo headphones. It is also recommended for brass band part practice and orchestra setting simulation. Simply place the instrument parts (sound sources) freely on the field, press the play button, and the ensemble you have constructed will sound three-dimensional. Experience the soft swell of the strings, the powerful roar of the brass, and the detailed accents of the percussion instruments, all in the space of your choice. The Ensemble Simulator uses Yamaha Corporation's Sound xR™ three-dimensional acoustic technology. “This application uses Sound xR spatial audio processing engine for earphones and headphones, i.e. Binauralizer from Yamaha Corporation .” Free creation of acoustic spaces Easy operation: Just place your own audio The composition is up to you: from traditional orchestras to avant-garde sound installations Unique musical experience: Build your own sound scene Simulation at home: Batch playback and placement simulation of individually recorded sound sources for wind bands and orchestras Session from a distance: Simulated sessions are possible by simply collecting and playing back the performance data of friends in remote locations Realistic orchestral experience Startup with a single playback button: All parts resonate simultaneously for a stunning sound Conductor's point of view: Conducting in a three-dimensional acoustic world through headphones or speakers Maximum immersion: Realism as if a live orchestra is playing right in front of you Immersive sound walkthrough Freedom of movement: Discover sound details by walking through the field and approaching specific parts Spatial expansion: Feel the deep harmonies in the string section and the powerful rhythms on the percussion side Sound Journey: A new kind of sound walk that feels like an exploration of the sound world Expandability to meet your creativity Import your own audio files: not only orchestral instruments, but also piano solos, ethnic instruments, electronic sounds, and more Free to create your own soundscape: Create your own unique sound space with new sound sources and combinations Sound Artist Experience: Unlimited possibilities to express your imagination and curiosity through sound Now, create the ideal musical space you envision and weave your own resonance. Orchestra, band, sound art - your sound will color the world. Translated with (free version)
row.short_description: 「アンサンブル・シミュレーター」は、あなた自身の楽曲データを用いて、 本物のオーケストラ指揮さながらの音楽空間を生み出せるシミュレーションゲームです。 フィールド上に楽器パート（音源）を 自由自在に配置 し、再生ボタンを押すだけで、あなたが構築したアンサンブルが立体的な響きを奏でます。弦楽器の柔和なうねり、金管の力強い咆哮、打楽器の細やかなアクセント――すべてをお好みの空間で体感しましょう。

row.name: Future Cowboy
row.detailed_description: Summary Your ranch has been burnt down, but there are traces of the perpetrator 'EquinoCorp' at the scene! You set off into the city to investigate the mystery behind its destruction, and to get revenge while somewhat helping out others along the way! A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge. Features - A Linear Story with Branching Narrative Choices - Wonderful Cast of Characters (including yourself as the titular Cowboy! - Interrogating suspects and chasing leads - A variety of mini-games to shake up the pace -Animated cutscenes for every level
row.short_description: A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge.

row.name: Down the Rabbit Hole Flattened
row.detailed_description: The immersive game Down The Rabbit Hole re-imagined for 2D! Down the Rabbit Hole is an award-winning title created initially for VR, set in an immersive diorama. For the first time, the game has been reimagined as a 2D point-and-click adventure, perfect for your casual flat-screen needs!  Down the Rabbit Hole Flattened will be made available for free for a limited time! If you appreciate the experience and own a VR headset, please consider checking out Down the Rabbit Hole and the spiritual successor, Escaping Wonderland, to support the developers.  About the game Down the Rabbit Hole is an adventure that takes place in Wonderland prior to Alice's arrival. You will discover a girl in search of her lost pet, Patches, that has wandered into Wonderland. Guide her as she moves through the mysterious world. But which way should she go? You control the girl’s fate by plotting her journey through an immersive diorama that wraps around you. Through the game’s many twists and turns, you will find yourself exploring the most wondrous corners of Wonderland, solving puzzles, uncovering secrets and making choices about the story along the way. • Multiple Playable Characters • Various Unique Puzzles • Hidden Collectibles
row.short_description: Down the Rabbit Hole is an adventure set in Wonderland prior to Alice's arrival. You will guide a girl who is looking for her lost pet by solving puzzles, uncovering secrets and making choices about the story along the way.

row.name: Scoop 'n Shoot
row.detailed_description: For centuries, the dark mage Kirusza has lusted after the magical crystals. His goal: unimaginable power. But the wise wizard Skovhir hid the crystals in the last place Kirusza would look: an unsuspecting ice cream parlor. Following Skovhir's death, the fate of the world now rests in your hands. As his apprentice, you have been chosen to continue both the business and the battle. Are you ready to serve up magical scoops and put a stop to Kirusza? Magical Ice Cream Factory Grow and harvest mystical plants to create powerful ice cream flavors. Each flavor unleashes destructive elemental forces effective against different types of enemies. Defend the Shop Kirusza has dispatched his minions, the Semacios, to destroy your business. Use your magical ice and your weapon to fight them off before they can reach the crystals. About the Project Scoop 'n Shoot is a passion project developed by our 5-person student team over the course of 1.5 years. We are proud to finally share the results of our hard work with you! A Note on Development : Since this is a completed student project, we cannot promise regular content updates or expansions. However, we hope you have as much fun playing it as we did making it. Feedback and reviews are always welcome and help us on our future paths as game developers!
row.short_description: Scoop 'n Shoot mixes gardening with frantic VR shooting action. Harvest extraordinary plants to create magical ice cream flavors, each with unique powers. Use your creations to blast away the evil magician Kirusza and his minions.

row.name: Pohinki Simulator
row.detailed_description: Pohinki Simulator is a survival game set in a polish neighbourhood, where you need to explore the open world in search for trash in order to survive and gain power. Explore the forgotten streets of Tarnow and find the treasures that others threw away in this abstract reality, filled with secrets waiting to be discovered. You wake up in the middle of the forest as a person known as 'Hu Man', from now on, your day-to-day life is roaming the streets in search for trash, after you collect what is needed to survive the next day, the choice of what you will be doing in your free time is yours - collecting scrap, becoming a thief, exploring the woods, building a base or going to a giant spider's BBQ party - you decide!  Pohinki Simulator aims for player freedom, because of that, if you aren't interested in survival, there is also an adventure mode where you don't have to worry about surviving and can freely experiment with multitude of mechanics the game gives you. row.name: The Seabed's Shining Star
row.detailed_description: In Hiroshima, there was an infamous shrine.  What was infamous about it, you might ask?  First, the shrine contained a god of desperation.  Gamblers, debtors, and gacha addicts came to pray.  Second, it was being used as a parking lot.  There wasn't a trace of divinity to be found.  Third, the shrine maiden couldn't care less.  She did the bare minimum. Pray, park, or leave.  As that dull shrine maiden swept the leaves,  a shooting star shot across the night sky.  She decided, as if she believed, to make a wish.  Before she could, the star crashed into her car.  'Across the vastness of space, we have arrived!'  ----------------------------------------------------- The Seabed's Shining Star is a leisurely two hour read. row.short_description: Under the hazy moon, a shrine maiden meets a star. A short visual novel of a two person conversation. Cup ramen recommended.

row.name: Menticide
row.detailed_description: This game was developed by a team of Clark University students, and was produced by Team EdgeCase. You play as a man having a mental breakdown. He tries to escape from his own mind and runs deeper into it. You play as his protector, drawing lines and moving him around to protect him from enemies that may or may not be real. This endless runner game is an analogue for mental health, and because of that you cannot win. You just try to get a better score than you did last time. There is a global leaderboard so you can compete with others, no matter where they are. Gameplay Instructions: Use the 'a' and 'd' keys, or the arrow keys to move left and right. Use your mouse to click and draw lines that will block off enemies line-of-sight, bounce projectiles away, keep the iron maiden from growing spikes, and to pickup additional health! You have a draw meter that will run out if you draw for too long. It will refill over time, but if it reaches zero, you will not be able to draw until it refills all the way. The trees will slow you down and let the hands catch up to you. Regain speed by sliding along the wall! If you are not happy with your run, press 'r' to reset emmediately. Meet the team. Producer: Milo Justice Programmer: William Titus Programmer: Lucian Terhorst Lead artist: Max Derienze Artist: Anthony Panasenko Artist: John De-Andrade Audio: Jack Hughes Designer: Charlie Schmerzler
row.short_description: Menticide is an endless runner where you protect a man running from himself. You draw lines to bounce the man around, block off enemies and cut through obstacles. Through strong symbolism and procedural rhetoric we are using the game as an analogue for mental health.
row.notes: Strong mental health themes. No suicide is depicted.

row.name: Routine Soul
row.detailed_description: An RPG Maker single-person independently developed fantasy adventure game that took thousands of hours to make. In terms of the plot, it is both a prequel and a sequel to the text adventure game ' Routine Soul (Chinese Name: 套路之魂) ' released in 2019. 'Being summoned to another world out of the blue, only to find the corpse of the summoner?! The continent eroded by filth, the legendary divine ring, the commission from the elves... People from all sides happen to gather at the notorious Lonely Mountain at this very moment. But what on earth is it for? When you finally fight your way bloodily to the top of the mountain relying on your own unknown power, is what's waiting for you really just the legendary evil dragon?' The gameplay lasts for more than 10 hours , full of collectible elements, and there's plenty to enjoy. Free choices . Will you follow your heart or restrain yourself by moral principles? This may determine the direction of the final ending! Multiple endings and multiple playthroughs are available . The main storyline adopts fragmented narration . Many details ( such as the descriptions of equipment and items ) hide clues to the truth. There are also countless Easter eggs. If you're a game enthusiast, you're sure to find your own surprises. The side quests are diverse in style . There are a small number of side quests with an extremely long span. In terms of the plot, there are ones that are hilariously off the rails, as well as sad and regretful ones, and even some that are dark, deep, and disturbing. There are quite a number of hidden quests, and if you're not careful enough, you're very likely to miss them. Strategic turn-based battles . Wonderful combinations of skill effects can create different playstyles. Find the weaknesses of your enemies and beat them until they doubt their existence! It's an innovative work under the framework of classic traditional RPGs, playing new and extraordinary routine with the trope of 'the brave traveling through another world'!
row.short_description: An RPG adventure game with Souls-like style. It features free exploration in a vast world, turn-based battles, collections of various equipment and skills, multiple endings and playthroughs. Under its magnificent and fantastical plot, there are countless Easter eggs and surprises hidden.

row.name: Crashed
row.detailed_description: Crashed is a third-person stealth adventure where you play as B.O.B. After his spaceship collided with an asteroid, he crash-lands on the quirky world of SnamSam. Upon waking, B.O.B. discovers that several parts of his ship have been looted by the local inhabitants, the Snailmen! Your mission? Reassemble the scattered pieces of your spaceship and escape! Navigate restricted areas brimming with patrolling guards and security cameras that track your every move. Keep out of sight to avoid detection or risk having nearby guards hunt you down. The goal is simple: retrieve your spaceship parts hidden deep the facility and escape. Utilize creative strategies, time your movement, and exploit shortcuts to outwit the Snailmen and slip through their defenses. Use Your Head... Take out Snailmen guards with B.O.B.’s detachable head! Launch it at unsuspecting guards from behind to knock their heads clean off, creating comedic chaos. Steal a guard’s head to open doors leading to restricted areas or unlock special shortcuts. Losing their heads is just a temporary inconvenience, and they’ll pop them right back on and keep going. Prepare for an unforgettable adventure where your head is your greatest weapon. Rebuild your ship, outwit the Snailmen, and escape SnamSam—if you can!

row.name: Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing - Prolog
row.detailed_description: NOTE: This free game is the official prologue to our main game Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing . You will solve a tricky case that takes place right before the main storyline of The Ebbing . This case is not part of the main game but serves as the narrative link between Part 1 and Part 2 of the Inspector Schmidt series. Valentin Schmidt, a Bavarian civil servant with truly bad timing, actually just wants to go on a well-deserved vacation to the North Sea. But right from the start, this is overshadowed by a drama: The captain of the steamship that is bringing Valentin and the other passengers to an idyllic North Sea island suddenly collapses during lunch and struggles for his life. Was the captain poisoned? Valentin is tasked with finding out what happened – and discovers a web of relationships, dependencies, and motives among the ship's crew and passengers that he must unravel to find the true culprit. Gameplay Explore the Open World: Move freely on the North Sea steamship in 1870 and search for clues. Initiate a Confrontation: Question the suspects and convict the perpetrators. Engage in Exciting Dialogues: Use the dialogue mechanic to interview passengers, gather intriguing information, and find out who is hiding something. Go on a Trail Hunt: Use your detective instinct to find hidden clues. Combine the Clues: Link information and findings to solve the case. Level Up: Develop your character and decide which skills you want to improve. Pass the Skill Checks: Use your skills in classic pen and paper skill checks (dice rolls). Craft Useful Items: Gather resources and build items and consumables to improve your skills. Make Difficult Decisions: Your actions affect the course of the story. Decide for yourself how you want to solve the tasks—through charisma, diplomacy, etc.—but the mission is clear: Solve the case! Setting The year is 1870. The first functioning transatlantic telegraph cable has been put into operation. It creates hope for a communication-rich and peaceful time between the USA and Germany. The world is coming closer together, and industrialization is also advancing by large steps. However, these changes are not only met with supporters among the population. And then there is also the Franco-Prussian War, which is causing unrest among the people, who are being conscripted out of fear. Valentin Schmidt, a young official from Bavaria, has just solved a tricky murder case in Wolpertshofen, Bavaria. As a thank you, Mr. Haller, the chief commissioner, sends him to the North Sea for rest. After the eventful crossing to Havstedt, Valentin is immediately confronted with the next mysterious death that needs to be cracked... Supported by funds from nordmedia – Film and Media Company Lower Saxony/Bremen Ltd.

row.name: Palm Cracker
row.detailed_description: Uncover secrets hidden in a relic of the digital age. You’ve acquired a mysterious PalmPilot from the notorious Crypt Killer, the smartest serial killer of the century. Somewhere in this device lies the key to unraveling his confession. But it won’t be easy. You’ll need to crack codes, solve cryptic riddles, and learn real-world decryption techniques in this immersive and challenging detective game. Are you ready to unlock the truth? From the creator of OS simulation titles like 128k, DISOWN95, After Hours, and Atom☭grad. Features Authentic PalmPilot Simulation : Explore the quirks and charms of this iconic device, re-created with loving attention to detail. Puzzles with Depth : Engage with brain-teasing challenges that blend logic, intuition, and real cryptographic concepts. Retro Nostalgia : Relive the magic of 2000s tech, complete with classic games, vintage apps, and handwriting recognition. Prefer your keyboard? That works too! What is the PalmPilot? The PalmPilot was a revolutionary personal digital assistant (PDA) released in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Designed for managing contacts, calendars, and notes, it became a favorite of tech enthusiasts for its portability, handwriting recognition, and early mobile games. In many ways, it was the first glimpse at the modern smartphone—just without the phone. I used to play with my dad’s PalmPilot all the time, and I recently found it in a storage unit. What do you know—after 20 years, it still had battery left! I turned it on and knew right away that I wanted to use it for a computer simulation. Palm Cracker is the result! Is the game really free? Yes! Palm Cracker is 100% free to play, own, and beat. There are no hidden fees or in-app purchases. Wishlist now!

Features: Custom pitch Echo Squares Auto-Purchase Squares 14 different instruments Mutiple scales Creative Mode - custom scale, speed, and number of squares
row.short_description: A casual musical idler. Ideal for background sounds while focusing on study or work.

Rogue Rubber
row.detailed_description: In Rogue Rubber, you play as a rubber duck fighting for survival against a horde of evil enemy ducks. Each level presents a different combination of constraints, enemies, and targets that must be destroyed before the tub runs out of water. Clear all 12 levels to be crowned the ultimate rubber ducky. After you shoot a bubble, you can swim over it to pick it back up as your supply is limited. Hitting an enemy with a bubble destroys the bubble but automatically refills its ammo slot. One hit from a bubble or bubble mine is enough to sink you or an enemy. Controls: WASD Movement Left click to shoot bubble, E or right click to place bubble mine
row.short_description: The ultimate bath battle. Blast your way through 12 waves of enemy ducks to become the ultimate bath-time companion in this point and click shooter.

row.name: A Tiny Snow Game
row.detailed_description: Get ready for an epic snowball showdown! Dive into this fun-filled couch co-op snow-fighting game designed for up to 4 players on one screen. Whether you're dodging snowballs, landing perfect throws, or outmaneuvering your opponents, every match is packed with laughter and excitement! Early Access This game is still in development, and I, a solo developer, am thrilled to share it with you in early access! Your feedback means the world to me and will help shape the game into its best version. Please feel free to report any bugs, suggest ideas, or share your thoughts—good or bad! Every bit of feedback makes a difference and is deeply appreciated. Key Features Couch Co-Op Fun : Play with friends and family locally using controllers. Perfect for game nights! Top-Down Perspective : Stay in the action with a clear bird’s-eye view of the snowy battleground. Kids Mode : A special mode with auto-aim assistance and forgiving difficulty, making it fun and accessible for younger players. Dynamic Gameplay : Sprint, slide, and dodge your way to victory while unleashing perfectly timed snowball throws. Various Game Modes : Keep the fun fresh with exciting ways to play. Charming Visuals : Experience a vibrant, cartoon-style winter wonderland that brings the frosty fun to life. Game Modes Free-For-All : Every snowballer for themselves—last one standing wins! King’s Crown : Race against time to earn points while wearing the crown! The crowned player scores extra points, but everyone else is out to take them down. Hold the crown the longest to win. Last Penguin : Watch out for the fishy smell! A mischievous penguin with a bomb chases the smelly player. If it catches them, they explode! Avoid the stink and outlast your friends to win. Campaign Mode : Face off against AI opponents in challenging scenarios and boss fights. Perfect for All Ages Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for some casual fun.  Grab a controller, gather your friends, and let the snowball battles begin!
row.short_description: Get ready for an epic snowball showdown! This fun couch co-op game for 1-4 players offers exciting modes like Free-For-All, King’s Crown, and a campaign. With vibrant visuals, dynamic gameplay, and a kid-friendly mode, it’s perfect for all ages. Join the frosty fun and share your feedback!

row.name: Rogue Worlds
row.detailed_description: Rogue Worlds is a roguelite platformer where you use the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. You'll need planning, wits and reflexes to make a way through these ever-changing death labyrinths. The game provides a free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds, with a shorter campaign and shared progress. Explore strange biomes, escape flooding poison, outwit gargantuan bosses. Do you play defensively with a repeater and energy shield, or swing into the fray with a boomerang and grapple hook? Do you scour the levels for potions and runes; or dive headfirst into the chaos? Along the way, unlock starting gear options, shortcuts, character perks, pets, and more. The friends you rescue on your journey will help you. Each procedurally generated run presents new hazards, layouts, and tactical decisions. You can further customize your build with runes, and gear modifiers that synergize in a myriad of ways. Veterans can push their limits by disabling perks or cranking up the difficulty for greater challenges—and greater rewards. Features Diverse Level Themes : Tidal corridors lined with mines, flickering lights in underground ruins, rising lava pits, and carnivorous gardens. Each environment brings unique dangers and opportunities. Creative Abilities : Master parkour, cloak from enemies, or even enthrall foes to fight on your side. Multi-Use Objects: Light your way with a lantern—or throw it as an improvised flaming Molotov. Challenging Boss Fights: Outsmart colossal adversaries by using both your reflexes and the environment to your advantage. Handcrafted Pixel Art & Animations: Beautifully detailed pixel visuals bring the world to life. Unique Musical Score: An immersive soundtrack that evolves with your adventure. Permanent Progression : Unlock new items, character backgrounds, and more to customize your journey. And much more awaits… Rogue Worlds is the free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds, with a shorter campaign and shared progress.
row.short_description: Rogue Worlds is a chaotic tactical roguelite platformer where you wield the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. Outwit powerful guardians and blast, dash, grapple, fight, and charm your way through ever-changing labyrinths!
row.reviews: “It’s refreshing and a hell of a lot of fun!” Double Jump

row.name: Clutch: The Drift Simulation
row.detailed_description: CLUTCH: THE ULTIMATE REALISTIC DRIFTING SIMULATOR Clutch is a passion project designed to deliver the most authentic drifting experience available in a 'game' format. Built for enthusiasts and professionals alike, Clutch simulates the intricacies of real-life drifting, from tire grip to throttle control, all wrapped in a highly moddable, community-driven package. FEATURES Continuously Evolving Experience: While still in its early stages, this game is a work in progress that will be continuously updated and improved based on player feedback and ongoing development. True-to-Life Driving Dynamics: Feel the road as you master clutch kicks, countersteering, and throttle modulation, all designed to replicate the physics of real drifting. Unmatched Modding Support: Expand the experience with fully open modding capabilities, giving players the freedom to create cars, tracks, and gameplay adjustments. Immersive VR Integration: Dive into the world of drifting with support for all major VR platforms, putting you directly in the driver’s seat. Universal Peripheral Compatibility: Whether you're using USB steering wheels, controllers, or other devices, Clutch ensures seamless support for your preferred setup. Interactive Spectator Mode: Relive the thrill of community drifting events by watching and interacting as others take on the track. Engage with the action, just like at a real drift meet. YOUR DRIFTING JOURNEY STARTS HERE Whether you're chasing the perfect line, looking to sharpen your skills, or creating your own custom experience, Clutch is built to evolve with you. With a focus on realism, fun, and community, this is more than a simulator—it’s a drift lifestyle.
row.short_description: Clutch is an effort to create the closest to real life car drifting simulation but in a “game” form. The goal is to create a professional level game that closest simulates real driving with the largest support for modding. The secondary goal is to mimic the fun of real life drifting and community.

row.name: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story
row.detailed_description: Happy Holidays! Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story is a point & click puzzle adventure with hand-drawn 2D graphics that tells the first part of a new story set in the Tales from Candleforth universe. Look, someone has left a present at your door! What could it be? Get ready to dive into this little preview of the next chapter of the story that surrounds Candleforth combining cozy aesthetics with a folk horror setting . Solve puzzles and riddles with escape room mechanics in this little preview that Candleforth has prepared for its most hardcore readers. Get ready for the next story of Tales from Candleforth Tales from Candleforth is a book containing traditional tales from this place, but something dark is mixing these tales in real life with the worst nightmares you can imagine. Are you ready to solve the mystery?
row.short_description: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story is a point & click puzzle adventure with hand-drawn 2D graphics and a cozy horror setting that tells a short story set in the Tales from Candleforth universe.

row.name: Skystead Christmas
row.detailed_description: 24 Hidden Skylets! In this festive-themed hidden object game, it’s your objective to find all of the hidden creatures on your Skystead. In a festive twist, every guess costs a snowball, and every snowball requires some snow! Collect snowflakes as they are fall across the screen and use your snowballs to try and find all 24 Skylets to win!
row.short_description: In this festive-themed hidden object game, every click costs a snowball, and every snowball requires some snow! Collect snowflakes as they are falling and try and find all 24 Skylets to win!

row.name: Cards, the Universe and Everything
row.detailed_description: The Only Card Game Where You Can Collect, Battle, and Trade… Everything. Ever wondered who’d win in a fight, Loki or a pug ? T-Rex vs Houdini ? Napoleon or the Sphinx ? In Cards, the Universe and Everything (CUE), these deeply important questions are finally answered. Collect the best of history, science, myths, nature and much more… No paywalls, just good old-fashioned wheeling and dealing with players across the world. Build your dream collection, track down and exchange rare cards, or hoard 37 copies of a Honey Badger just for the hell of it. With over 5,000 cards spanning everything from black holes to Black Hawks, you can build decks that are brilliant, bizarre, or just plain unfair. In case you're wondering, that's more than 434 quintillion possible card combinations per round, so things never get boring. Sure, Space, History and Science might sound like a school project, but really, it’s mostly shouting as Henry VIII flattens your quantum physicist and the angry goose you just played ruins everything. Each arena has its own twists, and every card is packed with curious facts to make defeat feel oddly enlightening. Win trophies, unlock powerful new cards, and collect rewards in regular events. Because who doesn’t love being rewarded for playing cards? Craft Special Cards and Fuse Duplicates Uncover secret recipes, combine duplicates, and create new cards with game-changing abilities. Or just melt down your spares in a blind panic after a crushing defeat.
row.short_description: Cards, the Universe and Everything is a unique trading card game with almost limitless possibilities: Dinosaurs, Norse gods, blue-footed boobies, Samurai, volcanoes, even the god particle. With the universe’s thingamabobs and endless strategies, are you ready for this gloriously bonkers game?
row.reviews: “A winning combination of gentle humour and eclectic trivia…” Droid Gamers “A solid, accessible, well-balanced card battler…” Gamezebo
row.notes: What can we say, reality gets a little mature sometimes. Everything in CUE is based on real-world history, science, art, and myth. If you can’t hack Chronos’ penchant for baby-eating (in text form), this probably isn’t the game for you.

row.name: Starling
row.detailed_description: Starling is a student-developed third-person base-building exploration game. As an employee of Starling Corp., your mission is to gather resources from across the galaxy and send it back to the corporation to supply your home planet with resources essential for survival. These cute creatures will guide and accompany you throughout your journey. Finding legendary items might unlock cosmetic for your new cosmic friends! Explore the world around you using your jetpack Delve into deep mines to extract valuable minerals Chop down alien trees for wood Fish in serene waters to secure essential supplies Upgrade your tools to access more resources Use these resources to upgrade your gear, repair your base, craft consumables and more! A catastrophic space incident has left your once-thriving space station in ruins, its fragments scattered across the galaxy. Now, it’s up to you to rebuild your base. By repairing various stations in your spaceship, you will unlock the ability to: Smelt ores and refine resources Craft essential items for progression Trade goods with the Starling Corp. Grow crops for supplies and buffs Customize your spacesuit at the cosmetic station
row.short_description: Starling is a student made third person base-building exploration game. As an employee of Starling Corp., your mission is to gather resources from across the galaxy. After an unexpected turn of events, you will need to rebuild your base while being assisted by adorable creatures known as starlings.

row.name: SpAIceRocks
row.detailed_description: 🚀 SpAIceRocks: Intergalactic Match 3 Mining Adventure Journey across a dystopian galaxy as an interplanetary mining prospector, matching and collecting valuable minerals across six uniquely haunting worlds. Each planet tells its own dark tale - from toxic swamps and polluted underbellies to frozen moons harboring ancient secrets. You just need a mouse to play.  Key Features: 🌎 Explore 6 Distinct Planets: Each with its own atmosphere, character, and exclusive minerals to mine 📈 Dynamic Board Expansion: Success unlocks larger mining operations - start small and expand up to 12x12 grids ⛏️ Strategic Mining Tools: Unlock and deploy powerful clearing tools: Plus Clearers: Clear minerals in a cross pattern Column Clearers: Clear entire vertical sections Row Clearers: Sweep across horizontal lines 💎 Unique Mineral Types: Each planet offers exclusive new minerals to collect and trade 🎯 Progressive Challenge: Clear boards to earn credits and unlock access to new worlds 🎮 Strategic Gameplay: Balance your moves, tool usage, and mineral matching to maximize profits 🏆 Level-Based Progression: Complete collection goals to advance and expand your mining operation Start your mining empire on a humble beginning world, then use your earnings to unlock access to new planets, each with their own valuable resources. But beware - every world has its own dark history and environmental challenges to overcome. Match three or more minerals to collect them, but plan carefully - you have limited moves to meet your collection goals. Use your earned credits wisely: invest in powerful clearing tools, unlock new mineral types, or save up to purchase rights to mine on new planets. Will you become the galaxy's premier mining magnate? Can you unlock all six worlds and uncover their mysterious histories? Start your cosmic mining adventure today! Perfect for fans of: Match-3 puzzle games with strategic depth Sci-fi themed games with dark atmosphere Resource management and progression systems Quick sessions with long-term goals 🎮 Your first mining operation awaits - ready to start your galactic enterprise? Also for AI Fans: SpAIceRocks is a Free to Play Unity 6 match 3 PC game for Steam that is being developed using as much AI as possible.   This open source game has been generated almost completely built with AI: - Game logic generated from Cline (VSCode plugin) + Claude AI & Unity Muse - Graphics from Midjourney processed with Rembg - Music from Udio - Sound effects from and (non-AI) - Font suggestions from a mixture of experts with ChatGPT's and Claude's suggestions winning out so far. - Special effects from Unity Particle Pack (non-AI) The trailer animation at the end was generated with Reflection Image to Text, it its sound track is an extended version of an Udio soundtrack in the game. Thank you to all the awesome providers above!   You can download the Unity game source and art from my site on github.
row.short_description: Journey across a dystopian galaxy as an interplanetary mining prospector, matching and collecting valuable minerals across six uniquely haunting worlds. You just need a mouse to play.  SpAIceRocks is a Unity 6 match 3 PC game for Steam that is being developed using as much AI as possible.

row.name: Heat incremental
row.detailed_description: From the creator of reactor idle, factory idle and city idle! Your mission is simple: HEAT UP THE PLANET , Yes, really. You’ll start with clean technologies like solar panels that barely produce any heat, but soon begin to research less clean methods to produce even more heat. Who knows—you might actually succeed in overheating the planet. Managing excessive heat, however, is not an easy task. Be prepared for challenges and, yes, explosions. MANY EXPLOSIONS. In your defense, explosions also help heat up the planet. Explosions cause financial losses and can bankrupt you though... This game introduces new features gradually. At first, you’ll see only the basics to help you get started, but as you progress, more advanced technologies and mechanics will unlock. It is a long journey with plenty to explore. Disclaimer: This game is HARD. It is also a form of a puzzle game, requiring you to figure out efficient strategies to improve your setup and boost your income. Keep in mind that perfection isn’t the goal—you’ll need to focus on specific areas and make trade-offs. Are you ready for the challenge?
row.short_description: Experience this new take on reactor and factory idle style game! More heat management, more building, more explosions! Hope you have fun!

row.name: Apartment Filled With Cats
row.detailed_description: Step into the cozy chaos of Apartment Filled With Cats , a heartwarming hidden object game featuring hand-drawn illustration bursting with charm and personality. Every nook and cranny of this whimsical apartment is a treasure trove of clever hiding spots for cats of all shapes and sizes. Perfect for cat lovers, puzzle enthusiasts, and anyone seeking a soothing escape, Apartment Filled With Cats invites you to slow down, explore, and enjoy the delightful details. With relaxing gameplay, playful surprises, and a soundtrack that feels as playful as a cat's purr, this game is the ultimate hidden object adventure. Grab a cup of tea, settle in, and uncover every last whiskered companion! Features 1 Level Unlimited Hints Settings
row.short_description: Uncover the purr-fect challenge in Apartment Filled With Cats! Explore charming, hand-drawn apartment filled with whimsical details as you search for cleverly hidden cats. Can you find them all? A relaxing, delightful journey awaits!

row.name: Decorporate
row.detailed_description: Decorporate is a local multiplayer platform-fighter game. It can be played by 1 to 4 players on a single computer. Controls support both Keyboard, USB controller and Bluetooth controller devices. Players can also choose to fight AI controlled characters, with three different levels of difficulty. The players control game characters who can Move horizontally, Jump, perform Attacks, or use their Special. The game plays like a typical platform fighter, but when a player kills an enemy, they evolve, changing into a new character with different stats and a new Special ability. Each character has a different Special ability: Bull CEO: the most powerful being, who can charge in a horizontal line, damaging everything in his path and only stopping when hitting a wall. Fox Manager: shoots in a horizontal line with a gun. Sheep Employee: she bring death and destruction to her enemies with a devastating vertical jump kick attack. Le Poulet : it's a chicken. Can rocket jump by shooting an explosive egg (downward vertical projectile). Hamster Weeb: only has a non-damaging dash for mobility. Can destroy the anime cassette to evolve into an Ascended Weeb, who can in turn permanently eliminate enemies from the game. There are three different Levels to fight on. The game has multiple gamemodes: Decorporate: basic gamemode: kill enemies to evolve in order to get to the Ascended Weeb evolution. Then, eliminate every other player on the field. Brawl: players have limited lives. Kill the others before they kill you! Otaku Outbreak: all againt one boss battle against a player-controlled Overpowered Ascended Weeb! Good luck!
row.short_description: Become the best weeb in the world!!!!!!!!

row.detailed_description: This is a rudimentary 2D platform decryption game Dozens of level mechanisms make up over 40 levels Players need to make good use of their locking and portal abilities to solve puzzles one by one Locking skill Portal pay attention to For proficient players in platform decryption, it may be a bit simple, but there may also be some surprises Lack of prompts, may cause blockage There are some bugs that developers cannot solve
row.short_description: Portal & Lock: A 2D Puzzle Platformer with Spatial Mastery

row.name: Abyssal Shade
row.detailed_description: Abyssal Shade is a deck building roguelike where you dive into a dungeon of the mind. Receive the blessings of your emotions and wield them to destroy the Shades that reside within! This game takes place in the void that consists of layers. Each layer has a long deck building roguelike section where you expand and use your deck from the previous floors to defeat your opponents. In between these card game segments there are a variety of top-down rpg puzzles that grant you rewards as you delve deeper into the layers. The battles consist of turn based combat where you play cards from your deck to summon allies and attack your enemy while defending yourself from damage. The game is on the shorter end last likely about 2 hours but is easily replayable with the chance to encounter new cards and develop new strategies.
row.short_description: Abyssal Shade is a deck building roguelike where you dive into a dungeon of the mind. Receives the blessings of your emotions through unique puzzles and expand your deck to protect yourself from the Shades.

Familiarise yourself with the enemy's moves, use skill combinations to recover the colourful crown, and calm the vision in the painting. tale This story is one of them characteristic · Exciting boss battles: Increase your power to face dangerous and powerful enemies · Classic RPG Experience: Experience the thrill of acquiring equipment and improving attributes About the game 'Colorful Crown' was independently developed and produced by one person in 2.5 months.
row.short_description: Rainbow Crown is a classic RPG adventure game. Fight powerful enemies in the game world. Grow stronger step by step by levelling up, getting equipment, and more, and finally reclaim the Colorful Crown!

row.name: First Steps in the NICU (Discovery edition)
row.detailed_description: Welcome to “First Steps in the NICU”! This game allows players to experience the world of neonatal care in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) . Through the perspectives of healthcare professionals and families, you will learn about infant care and preparations for life after discharge. Game Overview • Story-driven progression Players take on the role of a nursing student participating in clinical training at a NICU. By collaborating with medical staff and families, you will learn the basics of neonatal intensive care, communication with patient families, and the challenges of transitioning from hospital to home care. • Decision-based story development The story presents choices that help players understand appropriate actions and decisions. Every choice is accompanied by explanations, enabling deeper learning and insight. • Realistic scenarios The game is supervised by neonatologists and NICU nurses, ensuring a faithful recreation of actual medical settings. Features • Approximately 1 hour of gameplay, with a save function that allows you to resume at any time. • Recommended for medical students or middle and high school students interested in healthcare. • Knowledge gained through the game can be applied in daily life or medical settings. Development Background This game was created with the support of the Yuumi Memorial Foundation for Home Health Care and under the supervision of the Department of Pediatrics at Shinshu University. Pediatricians and students collaborated to turn the real challenges of medical practice into an accessible game. Recommended For • Those interested in medical or welfare fields • Families with NICU experience • Anyone curious about societal challenges Development Team • Supervision and Production: Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University – Yukihide Miyosawa Experience the world of neonatal care with “First NICU Experience” . Through gameplay, you’ll gain insight into the lives of babies, their families, and the dedicated medical teams who support them.
row.short_description: Welcome to “First NICU Experience”! Experience neonatal care in this serious game. As a nursing student, work with medical staff and families to care for infants and tackle post-discharge challenges. With interactive choices and story-driven gameplay, learn key skills in 1 hour.

row.name: Sixteen Undead
row.detailed_description: Tear up the highway as Jimmy 'Stitch' Munroe - teenage rebel and undead menace! Brought back to life after a mad scientist's experiment goes wrong, Stitch hits the road on the run from the cops trying to bag him and tag him. In this intense endless driving game, you'll need quick reflexes and a lead foot to stay one step ahead of the law! If you're in a tight situation an emergency boost will help you escape! Compete for glory on the local leaderboard and challenge your friends' high scores Choose your challenge! The 'Braindead' easy mode is perfect for learning the ropes, or try 'Deathwish' mode - the ultimate challenge with enhanced score multipliers and an exclusive leaderboard badge! DYNAMIC SYSTEMS: A procedurally generated highway, no two runs are the same! Adaptive difficulty increases the challenge the longer you survive Dynamic traffic keeps you on your toes The Cops are always on your tail, watch the distance meter or catch a view in your rearview to keep this thrilling chase going!  BLAST YOUR EARDRUMS! Rock out on the chase of your life with the face-melting riffs of JOYFUL TOY , and go apesh*t to North Korea's simian sensation: THE CONG ! This exclusive high-octane soundtrack will keep the energy high and the intensity cranked to 11.
row.short_description: Drive Like Hell! A high-octane chase through the endless desert! Dodge cops, rock out and tear up the road as a stitched-up teenage Frankenstein!

row.name: Recoil
row.detailed_description: An action platformer on a distant planet, where your objective is getting home after crashing behind enemy lines. You'll need your trusty pistol; not to kill, but to explore. Along the way, you'll come face-to-face with the enemy, and find you have far more in common than you ever expected. You'll use this gun (and any others you find) not to kill, but to explore: destroying obstacles with bullets and using the gun's powerful recoil to navigate stages. You'll learn the history and language of a not-so-alien world with not-so-alien inhabitants, explore their past and present settlements, and make decisions that alter the course of both species' histories.

row.name: Pawn Shop: Simulator
row.detailed_description: Pawn Shop: Simulator Welcome to the world of ' Pawn Shop: Simulator ' – a unique game where you step into the shoes of a pawn shop owner! Experience the thrill of negotiations, trading, and building your empire while uncovering the stories behind every item that lands on your counter.                                 Trade with customers and offer prices with profit in mind.                                                 Participate in auctions to stock up your pawn shop inventory.                                                                     And through it all, watch out for the police...
row.short_description: Pawn Shop Simulator is an exciting simulation game where you take on the role of a pawn shop owner. Your mission is to manage your inventory, negotiate prices with customers, and grow your business.

row.name: O.W.L. - One Wave Length
row.detailed_description: The Symphonie Forest was once a place of harmony, where melodies flowed with the rivers and every creature moved in sync with the sound of the world. But that harmony has been shattered. The Meowestro , a wicked tyrant, has unleashed waves of dissonance, corrupting the very heart of the forest. The once-peaceful denizens now march to his command, their souls bound by the chaos. Only you - Stryx the Owl and Katt the Cat can withstand against the rising army of foes. Armed with your instruments you must battle through the different seasons of the forest, strike in sync and restore the music to it's people. So listen to the Music patterns your enemies make and predict their attacks to reach the final boss, Meowestro. Your trusty shiny seller is able to take the shinies you collect and gives you small stat increases in return. Every bonfire you encounter you unlock powerful new Instruments that will aid you through your journey, increasing your damage and overall stats.
row.short_description: OWL is top down, rogue like bullet-hell that you can play with up to 1 friend. Everything is in beat, including your and the enemies attacks. With each new Instrument, new attack patterns unfold for you which will take you to your final obstacle; The Meowestro, the source of dissonance.
