Collect hearts to reveal Valentina's allure, with her undressing as you progress. Experience the excitement of the hunt as you explore each scene, eagerly anticipating her seductive secrets. Key Features 🗺️ Embark on a sensual heart-hunting adventure with the captivating Valentina. 🎮 Explore five beautiful-looking levels. 💖 Look for hidden hearts in each scene to further reveal Valentina's seductive charm. 🔞 Enjoy an erotic gaming experience suitable for adult audiences.
row.short_description: Embark on a sensual heart-hunting adventure with Valentina, a charming young woman. In this hidden object game, explore each location to discover what lies beneath Valentina's enticing layers.
row.notes: The mature content is exclusively female nudity, except for the final sex scenes which include male genitalia as well. Sex is consensual, no drugs, no alcohol.

row.name: Melt Abyss
row.detailed_description: ・Dual protagonists that can be switched at will You can switch between the two protagonists Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua at will to explore the city freely. ・A variety of VTUBER’s signature skills There are more than a dozen of VTUBER’s signature skills appearing in the game, such as the famous “Ui Beam”. ・Different bonds with different VTUBERs In the city, Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua will fight or talk with different VTUBERs, and different VTUBERs will have different attitudes towards the two protagonists.
row.short_description: A fan action game for Meaqua. An ominous vortex 'Abyss' appears above the city, and the city's order is collapsing. Kagura Mea and Minato Aqua, who have lost their memories, receive a call from the city. In order to solve the mystery of themselves, they embark on the road to return home.

row.name: Kill the Twister
row.detailed_description: A Storm is Approaching... In this self contained FPS boss fight, players will use a dynamic movement system to navigate the scores of rubble orbiting an enormous tornado. While dodging falling debris, cyclones and lightning strikes, players will hunt down explosives to hurl into the tornado, then blast them with a shotgun to deal massive damage. With a rough completion time of around 30 minutes, this game is designed to offer a brief and exciting challenge to FPS players new and old alike! Some time in the 90's, probably... An unprecedented storm has gripped the region. The Weatherman, premier meteorologist for Channel 27 News, returns to his workplace to prepare for the worst. From the west, chaotic winds begin to converge... Gameplay Features: Move, jump and ground slam to propel yourself further Pick up, throw and blow up props, crates and barrels Wander around a detailed office environment Simplified control scheme with controller support and full rebinding options Difficulty settings to welcome FPS newcomers and veterans Sodas in the break room
row.short_description: Jump, shoot, and throw a lot of barrels in this self-contained FPS boss fight against a massive tornado.

row.name: Nyxerion
row.detailed_description: This is an independent project developed by two people. It was created with limited resources and a light-hearted spirit. Please approach it for what it is, without expecting too much. Development is ongoing: updates and patches will be released regularly. The developers are also available on the Discord of the game to chat, gather feedback, and play with the community.
row.short_description: In Nyxerion, the gods have chosen you, not for their glory but for their amusement. Fight for your survival, wielding mystical powers in ruthless arenas. Challenge friends and foes in epic battles under the gods' cruel gaze. Will you fall, or will you rise to triumph?

row.name: 10 Seconds
row.detailed_description: 10 Seconds is a game that hinges on its innovative design . You are trapped in a failed time loop experiment, where you have 10 seconds to scramble for supplies and safety before a monster is released to hunt you down. Crawl through vents, scour walls, find tools and twist valves. Doing everything you can to escape being eaten alive. When you die, you wake up back at the start. Though you may notice that not everything has gone back to normal. Perhaps the experiment was not perfected before things went awry? This game is designed to be completed in one sitting, only taking about 30 minutes for a single run, so there is no save feature. Make use of the physics system that allows you to pick up and throw items. It may be more useful than you think!
row.short_description: Time loop puzzle horror, where you're stuck in a failed experiment and must escape or face being eaten for eternity.
row.notes: There's a gun and some skeletons, and when you die it sounds squishy and gross.

row.name: Project Hangman
row.detailed_description: Project Hangman is a multiplayer hangman game made in the Blazium Engine, that utilizes Blazium's built-in multiplayer lobby system. Create Lobbies, join games, and play with multiple friends in this basic hangman game where hilarity can ensure. Enter Any Word Or Phrase Feel free to go crazy and type in any wacky or weird word you can think of to confuse your friends. The harder the word is to guess the better your chances to win will be. Watch out though because for every letter your friends guess correctly they will receive points! Also Available on Other Platforms Play anywhere and everywhere! Hangman is also available on the Google Play Store, Apple App store, and Itch.io store. Play seamless cross platform Coop with all your friends without limitations.
row.short_description: Enjoy the classical game of Hangman with friends.
row.notes: Project Hangman contains acts of hanging, death, and dismemberment.

row.name: Helbreath USA
row.detailed_description: Helbreath USA is a classic 2D fantasy MMORPG that immerses players in a world of epic battles, diverse characters, and strategic gameplay. Choose your path as a Warrior or Mage, and customize your character with powerful equipment and abilities. Engage in intense open-world PvP battles as two rival factions clash for dominance. Explore a dynamic world filled with unique monsters, challenging quests, and opportunities for progression through hunting, PvP, and cooperative missions. Whether you’re conquering massive sieges or mastering your skills in one-on-one duels, Helbreath USA offers a timeless experience for both seasoned adventurers and new players.
row.short_description: Helbreath USA brings relentless action and strategic warfare as Elvine and Aresden battle for supremacy. Engage in massive PvP, conquer towns, hunt rare monsters, and customize your hero with powerful spells and gear. Forge alliances, claim treasures, and leave your mark on the battlefield.
row.notes: In Helbreath, mature content includes fantasy violence depicted through combat with monsters, faction battles, and PvP. There are no depictions of sexual acts, sexual assault, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm. The game focuses on strategic warfare and character progression in a fantasy setting.

row.name: Mid
row.short_description: Each click and contribution shifts the balance. Accumulate 100 Steaks to craft one of the limited Bone items; each Bone is tradable and fuels an endless cycle of strategy and scarcity. Are you ready to master the MID and dominate the Bone market?

row.name: Bongo Cat
row.detailed_description: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find? Item drop pool chances*: Common - 90% Uncommon - 9.5% Rare - 0.49% Epic - 0.01% Legendary - 1 in 500000 *Subject to change Features: Your own bongo cat Many customization options A friend while working hard Based on the artwork and meme of @StrayRogue
row.short_description: Bongo cat needs your help. Bongo cat needz more hatz!!! Every time you press a key, Bongo cat will punch your taskbar. Type, click, play, work to collect more points. Which hats will you find?

row.name: 我和妹妹的日常~
row.detailed_description: Game Instructions Presenting a story in the form of the most well-known (short) visual novel since the 21st century! In the game, you will play as the protagonist to experience the daily love life with a beautiful girl and reach different endings through different choices. This is my debut work. Although it is not yet mature, I still hope it can bring you a wonderful experience. Game Introduction Each big story is pieced together from small stories. In an unremarkable urban setting, the daily life of 'me' and 'my' sister is a tiny story within the big story of 'my' life. In this little story, something happens between the two of us, and our relationship changes. Meanwhile, this will have some unknown impact on 'my' future. That's it, something insignificant and extremely small. However, am 'I' the player outside the screen or the 'I' who is the elder brother in the story? Development & Acknowledgments Producer: 隐藏 123 Script: 隐藏 123 Program: 隐藏 123 Art: 浮流 flo (Sister's character illustration), みんちりえ (Background art) Music: 魔王魂，T - STUDIO Sound Effects: 效果音ラボ，T - STUDIO Special Thanks: 晚生桉，all family members and friends who provided help
row.short_description: This is a daily story about 'me' and 'my' sister. 'I' need to make different choices in order to reach the final outcome. 'I' was right to do that, right?

row.name: TeeDee
row.detailed_description: TeeDee is a charming 2D indie game that delivers a straightforward and enjoyable tower defense experience. Perfect for both casual players and genre enthusiasts, TeeDee combines simplicity with strategy to create an engaging gameplay loop. Three unique towers to choose from, each with its own strengths and strategic uses. Six handcrafted maps , offering diverse challenges and layouts to test your tactics. Four types of monsters , each with distinct abilities and behaviors to keep you on your toes. Whether you're a fan of tower defense games or just looking for a fun, bite-sized indie game, TeeDee is ready to challenge your skills. Prepare your defenses, build your towers, and defend your territory in TeeDee
row.short_description: A minimalist 2D tower defense game with 3 towers, 6 maps, and 4 monster types. Simple, fun, and perfect for quick strategy sessions!

row.name: Thin Line
row.detailed_description: You lost consciousness in the middle of a riot, dying. You watched yourself took the escalator to the heaven, and failed to qualify. You fell to the boiling hell. When you woke up, you found yourself in a strange place. Will you find the place you want and rest in peace, or regain what you lost and come back from the dead? First person horror adventure Dimly lit but visible scene Simple puzzles Narrative through in-game cell phone messages, text, etc Multiple endings
row.short_description: A short time before fading away.
row.notes: This game contains blood and disturbing images.

row.name: Newton
row.detailed_description: The legend says Newton dreamed of apples... A lot! Newton is a solo 2D pixel art  arcade- platformer game made with Unreal Engine 5. Collect apples, master gravity and set high score in this simple but challenging adventure! Master Unique Powers Invert gravity. Grab the teleportation apple. Teleport instantly to the next spot! Become the Best Challenger Train and improve locally, beat the high scores, and become the top player on the online leaderboard! Unlock the Codex Discover the good, the bad, and the quirky apples: Find the hidden apples. Learn each apple’s unique properties. Check your personal counter. Master all their secrets.
row.short_description: Newton is a solo 2D pixel art Arcade-platformer. In this historical retro-fantasy game, you will collect apples, master gravity and set high score in this simple but challenging adventure!

row.name: Elect
row.detailed_description: Elect is a multiplayer political simulation game. Join or lead a political party, run in elections, vote on laws, and balance the budget in the United States and 15+ other countries. Become your country's leader and declare wars, send foreign aid, appoint a cabinet, fight pandemics, vote in the United Nations, and more.
row.short_description: Elect is a multiplayer political simulation game. Run in elections, join or lead a political party, and vote on laws in the U.S. and 15+ other countries. Become your country's leader and declare wars, send foreign aid, appoint a cabinet, fight pandemics, vote in the United Nations, and more.
row.notes: Includes features relating to the legality of sex, drugs, alcohol, smoking, euthanasia, and gambling, as well as terrorism and assassination.

row.name: A Very Merry Nightmare
row.detailed_description: A Very Merry Nightmare is a 3D First-Person game made in Unreal Engine. The story follows a young boy named Oliver on Christmas Eve who follows a mysterious doll to another world full of Christmas decorations, however, things are not as wonderful as they seem. Oliver must then figure out how to make it back home before it is too late.  Some features include an AI enemy that can both watch the player from a distance and chase the player when prompted. An interact system with objects like drawers, cabinets, and doors. Players can also eat the various sweets in the world and find hidden notes left throughout the environment.  This game was my Senior Project for my major and was made in 16 weeks. It was also my first project in Unreal Engine. I was the sole creator of the game handling everything but the sound (sourced from Splice) and the 3D modeling (sourced from Unreal Engine Marketplace). I am open to feedback and will have a place for submissions of any issues you might have. I will be taking all feedback into account and am open to adding more to the game in the future. I truly hope you all enjoy this game and I look forward to your feedback!
row.short_description: A First-Person 3D Christmas Thriller Game

row.name: The Closing Shift
row.detailed_description: A short story about you working a closing shift at the restaurant when there is an unexpected occurance with the killer lurking in the town. But while finishing up your shift alone, things don't go as expected. Expect a first person experience with immersive sound, where you interact with NPC and objects around the resturant in order to close the restaurant.
row.short_description: A short interactive first-person horror game. Walk, look around, and talk to people to finish the short story about closing your restaurant. Complete the story with immersive sounds, and spooky tension and jumpscares to keep you focused.
row.notes: Game contains some flashing lights and dead bodies.

row.name: F.O.R.S
row.detailed_description: In this high-stakes shooter, firepower alone won’t be enough you need quick thinking too. At the start of each round, attacking players must answer general knowledge questions. Answer correctly, and you’re safe. Get it wrong, and you’ll suffer a deadly disadvantage your health will slowly drain, and your location will be revealed to everyone. The only way to remove the penalty? Reach key zones on the map. But be careful your enemies know where you’re going and will be waiting to take you down. Will you fight through the chaos, outsmart your opponents, or risk it all to recover? Only the smartest and most skilled players will survive. There is a also a deathmatch mode for players to test their combat skills in a free-for-all battle.
row.short_description: This intense shooter combines combat with trivia, answering questions correctly keeps you safe, while wrong answers drain your health and reveal your location. To recover, you must reach risky map zones, but enemies will hunt you. Only the smartest and most skilled will survive.
